MBE 不动产法考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts & Forgery
正确答案：A

银行胜诉，因为对解除抵押文件（Release）的篡改是无效的。

核心法律原则

本题考察的是不动产转让中“无效” (Void) 与 “可撤销” (Voidable) 文件的区别，以及其对善意购买人 (BFP) 的影响。

规则 (Rule)： 伪造 (Forgery) 或经过实质性篡改 (Material Alteration) 的契据或法律文件是自始无效 (Void ab initio) 的。

即使该文件被登记 (Recorded)，且后续购买人是善意的 (BFP)，该文件依然无效。登记行为不能“洗白”一份无效的文件。

详细推理逻辑

1. 篡改等于伪造 (Alteration is Forgery)
该女子虽然合法获得了地块2的解除抵押文件，但她擅自修改文件内容，加入了地块5。这种对法律文件的物理篡改属于伪造行为。

2. 无效文件的法律后果 (Effect of Void Instrument)
因为关于地块5的解除是伪造的，所以在法律上，银行从未释放地块5的抵押权。该文件关于地块5的部分是Void (无效) 的。

3. 登记法案的局限性 (Limits of Recording Acts)
题目中引用的登记法案（Race-Notice Statute）旨在保护 BFP 免受“未登记的有效权益”的影响。但是，登记法案不能保护 BFP 免受“无效文件”的影响。

换句话说，BFP 只能在“前手拥有可撤销头衔 (Voidable Title)”时受到保护，而在“前手拥有无效头衔 (Void Title)”时无法受到保护。

类型 原因示例 对 BFP 的影响
无效 (Void) 伪造 (Forgery)
实质性篡改 (Alteration)
未交付 (Non-delivery)		 BFP 败诉
原权利人保留权益
可撤销 (Voidable) 欺诈诱导 (Fraud in the inducement)
胁迫 (Duress)
错误 (Mistake)		 BFP 胜诉
BFP 截断原权利人的撤销权
选项辨析
  • 选项 A (正确)： 篡改导致文件无效。既然文件无效，该男子（即使是 BFP）也无法依据该文件获得优于银行的权利。
  • 选项 B (错误)： 即使该男子进行了所有合理的调查也无法发现篡改，结果也是一样的。他输掉官司不是因为他没有调查，而是因为源文件是无效的。
  • 选项 C (错误)： 这是一个常见的陷阱。虽然他信赖了登记记录 (Reliance on record)，但在美国财产法中，登记并不能验证伪造的文件 (Recording does not validate a forgery)。
  • 选项 D (错误)： 银行没有义务去持续监控登记记录以防止伪造。此外，伪造风险通常由接受伪造文件的一方（即该男子）承担，而非被伪造签名的受害方（银行）。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：

在处理 BFP 题目时，第一步永远是检查“链条的有效性”。如果题干中出现了“Forgery”（伪造）或“Alteration”（篡改），警钟应立即敲响：这是一份 Void 文件。无论后续购买者多么无辜（Innocent），无论他是否登记，他通常都会输给原权利人。

questions.question:
Twenty years ago, a man who owned a 20-acre ranch agreed to sell all of his mineral rights to his neighbor. The man executed a warranty deed conveying the mineral estate to the neighbor, who failed to record the deed.
The following year, a woman moved her mobile home onto an undeveloped five-acre portion of the man's ranch. After the woman had lived on the property for 10 years, a local drilling company began operations on a nearby tract to drill a natural gas well. Believing that the woman owned the property, the drilling company approached the woman about leasing the mineral rights on her property and requested that the woman sign a lease of her mineral rights. The woman signed the lease as requested, and it was promptly and properly recorded. The drilling operations were successful, and the drilling company prepared to distribute profits from royalties. However, a dispute arose between the neighbor and the woman, as both parties claim ownership of the minerals.
The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
In an action to determine title, is the court likely to award title to the mineral estate to the woman?

choices.a: No, because the woman actually possessed only the surface estate that had previously been severed from the mineral estate.
choices.b: No, because the woman did not actually possess the mineral estate until she signed the lease of the mineral rights.
choices.c: Yes, because the neighbor failed to record the warranty deed conveying the mineral estate.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman adversely possessed both the surface estate and the mineral estate for the statutory period.

questions.question:
A woman entered a hospital to undergo surgery and feared that she might not survive. She instructed her lawyer by telephone to prepare a deed conveying her property, a large tract of undeveloped land, as a gift to her nephew who lived in a distant state. Her instructions were followed, and, prior to her surgery, she executed a document in a form sufficient to constitute a deed of conveyance. The deed was recorded by the lawyer promptly and properly as she instructed him to do. The recorded deed was returned to the lawyer by the land record office. The woman, in fact, recovered from her surgery and the lawyer returned the recorded deed to her.
Before the woman or the lawyer thought to inform the nephew of the conveyance, the nephew was killed in an auto accident. The nephew's will left all of his estate to a satanic religious cult. The woman was very upset at the prospect of the cult acquiring the property.
The local taxing authority assessed the next real property tax bill on the property to the nephew's estate.
The woman brought an appropriate action against the nephew's estate and the cult to set aside the conveyance to the nephew.
If the woman loses, what will be the likely reason?

choices.a: Delivery of the deed is presumed from the recording of the deed.
choices.b: Disappointing the nephew's devisee would violate the religious freedom provisions of the First Amendment to the Constitution.
choices.c: The gift of the property was inter vivos rather than causa mortis.
choices.d: The showing of the nephew's estate as the owner of the property on the tax rolls supplied what otherwise would be a missing essential element for a valid conveyance.

一名女子入院接受手术，担心自己可能无法生还。她通过电话指示其律师准备一份地契，将其财产——一大片未开发的土地——作为礼物赠与她居住在外州的侄子。律师遵从了她的指示，在手术前，她签署了一份形式上足以构成转让契据的文件。律师按照她的指示，及时且适当地登记了该地契。土地登记处将已登记的地契返还给了律师。事实上，该女子手术后康复，律师将已登记的地契交还给了她。

在该女子或律师想到要通知侄子有关此次转让之前，侄子在一场车祸中丧生。侄子的遗嘱将其所有遗产留给了一个撒旦教派。该女子对于该教派可能获得此财产的前景感到非常不安。

当地税务机关将该财产的下一期不动产税单开给了侄子的遗产管理方。

该女子对侄子的遗产管理方和该教派提起了适当的诉讼，以撤销对侄子的财产转让。

如果该女子败诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. Delivery of the deed is presumed from the recording of the deed.
地契的交付因地契的登记而被推定成立。

B. Disappointing the nephew's devisee would violate the religious freedom provisions of the First Amendment to the Constitution.
使侄子的遗赠继承人失望将违反宪法 First Amendment 的宗教自由条款。

C. The gift of the property was inter vivos rather than causa mortis.
该财产的赠与是生前赠与 (inter vivos) 而非临终赠与 (causa mortis)。

D. The showing of the nephew's estate as the owner of the property on the tax rolls supplied what otherwise would be a missing essential element for a valid conveyance.
税务登记册上将侄子的遗产管理方列为财产所有人，弥补了有效转让中本可能缺失的关键要素。
data.explanation:
A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:
  • delivered - presumed when the deed (1) has been recorded - ie, filed in the official land records - or (2) is in the grantee's physical possession and
  • accepted - presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee.
Once these requirements are met, the grantee owns the property and the transfer cannot be canceled - even if the land record office later returns the deed to the grantor.

Here, delivery of the deed to the nephew is presumed since the woman's lawyer (agent) recorded it as instructed. And though the nephew never learned of the deed, his acceptance is presumed since the conveyance benefited him. As a result, ownership of the property transferred to the nephew and was unaffected by the land record office's return of the recorded deed. Therefore, the woman will likely lose her action to set aside the conveyance.

(Choice B) The religious freedom provisions of the First Amendment protect persons from government action - not private individuals (as seen here). Therefore, disappointing the satanic cult by setting aside the conveyance would not violate protected religious freedoms - even if the woman had asked the court to do so because she disapproved of satanism.

(Choice C) An inter vivos gift is an irrevocable gift of land or personal property given during the grantor's life. A causa mortis gift is a revocable gift of personal property given in expectations of the grantor's imminent death. Therefore, though the woman gifted the land when she feared that she might not survive surgery, that gift could only be inter vivos. And since that inter vivos gift only became irrevocable when it was delivered and accepted, the woman will lose because the deed was delivered (and presumably accepted) when it was recorded.

(Choice D) A conveyance by deed is valid once there is delivery and acceptance. Whether the nephew's estate appeared as the owner of the property on the tax rolls is irrelevant.

Educational objective: A deed transfers ownership of real property once it is delivered (presumed when it has been recorded) and accepted (presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee). After this occurs, the transfer is irrevocable.



选项正确率统计：A选项 81%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 11%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

地契是一份文件，一旦满足以下条件，即可将不动产的所有权从所有者（出让人）转移给另一方（受让人）：
  • 交付——当地契（1）已被登记——即在官方土地记录中存档——或（2）由受让人实际占有时，交付即被推定成立，并且
  • 接受——当转让对受让人有利时，接受即被推定成立。
一旦满足这些要件，受让人即拥有该财产，且转让不可撤销——即使土地登记处事后将地契返还给出让人。

在本案中，地契向侄子的交付被推定成立，因为该女子的律师（代理人）按其指示进行了登记。尽管侄子从未得知该地契的存在，但由于该转让对他有利，其接受被推定成立。因此，财产所有权已转移给侄子，且不受土地登记处返还已登记地契这一行为的影响。因此，该女子请求撤销转让的诉讼很可能会败诉。

（选项B）First Amendment 的宗教自由条款保护个人免受政府行为的侵害——而非私人行为（如本案所示）。因此，通过撤销转让而使撒旦教派失望，并不会侵犯受保护的宗教自由——即使该女子是因为不赞成撒旦教而请求法院这样做。

（选项C）生前赠与 (inter vivos gift) 是出让人在生前作出的、不可撤销的土地或个人财产的赠与。临终赠与 (causa mortis gift) 是出让人在预料自己即将死亡时作出的、可撤销的个人财产的赠与。因此，尽管该女子是在担心自己可能无法在手术中生还时赠与该土地，但该赠与只能是生前赠与 (inter vivos)。由于该生前赠与 (inter vivos gift) 只有在交付和接受后才变得不可撤销，所以该女子将会败诉，因为地契在登记时即已完成交付（并被推定接受）。

（选项D）通过地契进行的转让一旦完成交付和接受即为有效。侄子的遗产管理方是否在税务登记册上被列为财产所有人，与此无关。

教学目标：地契一旦完成交付（登记即推定交付）和接受（转让对受让人有利即推定接受），即转移了不动产的所有权。此后，该转让不可撤销。

MBE 考点解析

不动产法 (Real Property) - 地契交付
核心规则：地契的交付 (Delivery of Deed) 不动产所有权的转移需要两个关键要素：
  1. 交付 (Delivery)：出让人 (Grantor) 必须表现出立即转移所有权的意图。
  2. 接受 (Acceptance)：受让人 (Grantee) 必须接受。如果赠与是有利的，通常推定接受。

1. 为什么该女子会败诉？

本题的关键在于判断所有权是否已经转移。如果所有权在女子手术前已经转移给了侄子，那么侄子死后，该财产就是他的遗产，由他的遗嘱（即给撒旦教派）处置。

根据法律规定，当出让人（或其代理人）将地契进行官方登记 (Recording) 时，法律上产生一个强有力的交付推定 (Presumption of Delivery)。

本案逻辑链：

  • 女子指示律师登记地契。
  • 律师（作为代理人）完成了登记。
  • 登记 = 推定交付。
  • 虽然侄子不知情，但因为是纯获益的赠与，推定接受。
  • 结论： 所有权在登记那一刻已经不可撤销地转移给了侄子。
✅ 正确答案：A "Delivery of the deed is presumed from the recording of the deed."
(地契的交付因地契的登记而被推定成立。)

这是导致女子败诉的直接法律原因。一旦推定成立且未被反驳（本案中没有证据显示她当时没有赠与意图），所有权即刻转移。事后她康复了想要反悔，或者侄子死了，都不能撤销已经完成的转让。

2. 为什么不是临终赠与 (Gift Causa Mortis)？

选项 C 错误分析：
考生常被“担心手术死亡”这一事实误导，认为这是 Gift Causa Mortis（因死因赠与，即可撤销的赠与）。

关键区别：
  • Gift Causa Mortis 仅适用于个人财产 (Personal Property)。
  • 不动产 (Real Property) 的赠与通常被视为生前赠与 (Inter Vivos Gift)。
一旦不动产地契完成交付，就是不可撤销的。女子康复的事实不能自动撤销不动产的转让。

3. 排除干扰项

  • 选项 B (宪法问题)： 这是一个典型的“红鲱鱼” (Red Herring)。宪法第一修正案限制的是政府行为，而不是私人财产纠纷。法院执行中立的财产法规则不违反宗教自由。
  • 选项 D (税务记录)： 税务记录并不是不动产所有权转移的必要条件或决定性因素。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
当题目中出现“撒旦教”、“纳粹”等引起情绪反感的受益人时，请务必保持冷静。这通常是测试你是否能忽略情感因素，严格适用财产法规则（如：地契一旦登记即视为交付，不可撤销）。

questions.question:
A seller owned property in fee simple, as the land records showed, when he contracted to sell the property to a buyer. Two weeks later, the buyer paid the agreed price and received a warranty deed. A week thereafter, when neither the contract nor the deed had been recorded and while the seller remained in possession of the property, a creditor properly filed a money judgment against the seller. The creditor knew nothing of the buyer's interest.
A statute in the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
The creditor brought an appropriate action to enforce her lien against the property in the buyer's hands.
If the court decides for the buyer, what will be the most likely reason?

choices.a: The buyer was a purchaser without notice.
choices.b: The doctrine of equitable conversion applies.
choices.c: The jurisdiction's recording act does not protect creditors.
choices.d: The seller's possession gave the creditor constructive notice of the buyer's interest.

一名卖方以完全保有地权（fee simple）的形式拥有一处房产，如土地记录所示，当时他与一名买方签订了出售该房产的合同。两周后，买方支付了约定价格并收到了一份附担保产权契据（warranty deed）。此后一周，在合同和契据均未登记，且卖方仍占有该房产的情况下，一名债权人对卖方正式提交了一份金钱判决。该债权人对买方的权益一无所知。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何正式提交的判决，自提交之日起十年内，均构成对该判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或随后获得的任何不动产的留置权。”

该司法管辖区的登记法规定：“任何不动产的转让或抵押，除非依法登记，否则对善意有偿且无通知的后续购买者无效。”

债权人提起适当诉讼，以对买方手中的房产强制执行其留置权。

如果法院做出对买方有利的判决，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The buyer was a purchaser without notice.
买方是一名无通知的购买者。

B. The doctrine of equitable conversion applies.
衡平法转换原则适用。

C. The jurisdiction's recording act does not protect creditors.
该司法管辖区的登记法不保护债权人。

D. The seller's possession gave the creditor constructive notice of the buyer's interest.
卖方的占有给予了债权人关于买方权益的推定通知。

Payment of value
(bona fide purchaser)


ValueNo value
  • Release of existing debt
  • Fair market value
  • Security for existing debt
  • Nominal payment (eg, $1)
  • Recital of consideration in deed
  • Gift, devise, or inheritance
Recording acts determine the priority of competing property interests. A notice statute (as seen here) only protects subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of an earlier property interest. Judgment creditors are not purchasers for value since the attachment of a judgment lien to a debtor's property is merely security for an existing debt - not payment of valuable consideration. Therefore, judgment creditors are not protected under the notice statute, and the creditor here cannot enforce her judgment lien.

(Choice A) Whether the buyer lacked notice would only matter if the buyer were trying to establish priority over an earlier property interest. Since the buyer has the earlier interest here, this information is irrelevant.

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of equitable conversion, the buyer receives equitable title after the parties enter a land sales contract. But this doctrine does not apply when, as here, the buyer acquired legal title - eg, by paying the purchase price and receiving the deed - before the judgment lien was obtained.

(Choice D) Inquiry notice (a form of constructive notice) exists when a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate - eg, visible use of the property. But here, whether the creditor had notice is irrelevant since she is not a buyer for value and the recording act does not apply.

Educational objective: Judgment creditors are not purchasers for value since the attachment of a judgment lien to a debtor's property is merely security for an existing debt - not payment of valuable consideration. Additionally, a judgment creditor can only enforce an interest in property that is owned by the debtor.

选项正确率统计：A选项 42%，B选项 21%，C选项 32%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

支付对价
（善意购买者）


有对价无对价
  • 解除现有债务
  • 公平市场价值
  • 为现有债务提供担保
  • 名义上的支付（例如1美元）
  • 契据中对价的记述
  • 赠与、遗赠或继承
登记法确定相互竞争的财产权益的优先顺序。通知型法规（如本案所示）仅保护对先前财产权益缺乏通知的有偿后续购买者。判决债权人并非有偿购买者，因为将判决留置权附加于债务人财产上仅仅是为现有债务提供担保——而非支付有价对价。因此，判决债权人不受通知型法规的保护，本案中的债权人无法强制执行其判决留置权。

（选项A）买方是否缺乏通知，仅在买方试图确立其相对于更早的财产权益的优先权时才有意义。由于本案中买方拥有的是更早的权益，因此该信息无关紧要。

（选项B）根据衡平法转换原则，在双方签订土地买卖合同后，买方获得衡平法上的所有权。但该原则不适用于本案情况，即在获得判决留置权之前，买方已经通过支付购买价款和接收契据等方式获得了法律上的所有权。

（选项D）当购买者知道或应当知道存在会促使一个理性人进行调查的情况时（例如，对房产的可见使用），就存在调查性通知（推定通知的一种形式）。但在本案中，债权人是否收到通知是无关紧要的，因为她并非有偿购买者，且登记法不适用。

教学目标：判决债权人并非有偿购买者，因为将判决留置权附加于债务人财产上仅仅是为现有债务提供担保——而非支付有价对价。此外，判决债权人只能对债务人拥有的财产权益强制执行。

References

46 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 352 (2018) (priority of judgment liens).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts & Priorities

🏆 正确答案：C

核心理由：在该司法管辖区的登记法（Recording Act）下，保护对象仅限于“购买者”（Purchasers），而不包括“判决债权人”（Judgment Creditors）。

1. 判决债权人 vs. 有偿购买者

这是本题的决胜点。MBE常考的一个概念是：判决债权人（Judgment Creditor）通常不被视为有偿购买者（Bona Fide Purchaser / Purchaser for Value）。

  • 购买者：支付了当下的价值（Value）来换取房产权益。
  • 判决债权人：其留置权（Lien）通常是为了担保“先前存在的债务”（Antecedent Debt），并没有为该特定的房产权益支付新的对价。
2. 法律条文的严格解读

题目中的登记法明确规定：

"No conveyance... shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value..."

既然法规只保护“Purchasers”，那么债权人（Creditor）就不能利用该法规来对抗未登记的契据。因此，案件回到普通法（Common Law）规则：“时间在先，权利在先” (First in time, first in right)。

买方在债权人提交判决前已经获得了契据（Deed），虽然未登记，但买方的权益产生得更早，因此买方胜诉。

3. 所有权的时间点

判决留置权法规规定，留置权仅附着于债务人“当时拥有”（then owned）的财产。当债权人提交判决时，卖方已经将契据交付给买方，法律所有权（Legal Title）已经转移。卖方此时已不再拥有该房产，因此留置权无法附着。

选项快速排查：

C. 该司法管辖区的登记法不保护债权人 (Correct)
这是最直接的法律依据。因为债权人不是“Purchaser for value”，所以无法利用登记法击败未登记的买方。
A. 买方是无通知的购买者
错误。Notice（通知）是用来评估后续权益持有人的。买方是在此之前的权益人，他是否有通知与本案优先权争议无关。
B. 衡平法转换原则 (Equitable Conversion)
错误。该原则适用于“合同签订后”到“交割（Closing）前”的阶段。本案中，买方已经支付价款并收到了契据（Deed），已经完成了交割，获得了完整的法律所有权（Legal Title），不再适用衡平法转换。
D. 卖方的占有构成推定通知
错误。即使卖方的占有给了债权人某种通知，这也不重要。因为债权人根本不受登记法保护（见选项C），无论他是否有通知，他都输给了时间在先的买方。
MBE 考试技巧：
做题时务必仔细阅读题目中给出的法规（Statute）文本。如果法规只写了 "Purchaser" 而没有明确包含 "Creditor"，千万不要默认债权人受保护。

questions.question:
A man owned a tract of undeveloped land. The man's land abuts a tract of land owned by the state's governmental energy agency. The agency has operated a waste-to-electricity recycling facility on its land for 12 years. Both the man's land and the agency's land are in a remote area, and the agency's land is the only developed parcel of real estate within a 10-mile radius. The boundary line between the man's land and the agency's land had never been surveyed or marked on the face of the earth.
During the past 12 years, some of the trucks bringing waste to the agency facility have dumped their loads so that the piles of waste extend onto a portion of the man's land. However, prior to the four-week period during each calendar year when the agency facility is closed for inspection and repairs, the waste piles are reduced to minimal levels so that during each of the four-week closures no waste was, in fact, piled on the man's land. Neither the man nor any representative of the agency knew the facts about the relation of the boundary line to the waste piles.
The time for acquiring title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
Last year, the man died, and his son succeeded him as the owner of the man's land. The son became aware of the facts, demanded that the agency stop using the man's land for the piling of waste, and, when the agency refused his demand, brought an appropriate action to enjoin any such use of the man's land in the future.
If the agency prevails in that action, what is the most likely reason?

choices.a: The facts constitute adverse possession, and title to the portion of the man's land concerned has vested in the agency.
choices.b: The interest of the public in the conversion of waste to energy overrides the son's entitlement to equitable remedies.
choices.c: The man's failure to keep himself informed as to the agency's use of his land and his failure to object constituted implied consent to the continuation of that use.
choices.d: The power of eminent domain of the state makes the son's claim moot.

The boundary line between the man's land and the agency's land had never been surveyed or marked on the face of the earth.

During the past 12 years, some of the trucks bringing waste to the agency facility have dumped their loads so that the piles of waste extend onto a portion of the man's land. However, prior to the four-week period during each calendar year when the agency facility is closed for inspection and repairs, the waste piles are reduced to minimal levels so that during each of the four-week closures no waste was, in fact, piled on the man's land. Neither the man nor any representative of the agency knew the facts about the relation of the boundary line to the waste piles.

The time for acquiring title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

Last year, the man died, and his son succeeded him as the owner of the man's land. The son became aware of the facts, demanded that the agency stop using the man's land for the piling of waste, and, when the agency refused his demand, brought an appropriate action to enjoin any such use of the man's land in the future.

If the agency prevails in that action, what is the most likely reason?

一名男子拥有一片未开发的土地。该男子的土地与州政府能源机构拥有的一片土地相邻。该机构在其土地上运营一座垃圾发电回收设施已有12年之久。该男子与该机构的土地均位于偏远地区，且该机构的土地是方圆10英里内唯一已开发的房地产地块。该男子与该机构土地之间的边界线从未在地面上进行过测量或标记。

在过去的12年里，一些运送垃圾到该机构设施的卡车在倾倒其装载物时，导致垃圾堆延伸到了该男子土地的一部分。然而，在每个日历年该机构设施因检查和维修而关闭的为期四周的期间之前，垃圾堆会被减少到最低水平，因此在每次为期四周的关闭期间，实际上没有垃圾堆积在该男子的土地上。该男子和该机构的任何代表都不知道边界线与垃圾堆之间关系的事实。

在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得所有权的时效为10年。

去年，该男子去世，儿子继承他成为该土地的所有者。儿子知晓了这些事实，要求该机构停止使用其土地堆放垃圾，并在该机构拒绝其要求后，提起了适当的诉讼，以禁止未来任何此类对该土地的使用。

如果该机构在该诉讼中胜诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The facts constitute adverse possession, and title to the portion of the man's land concerned has vested in the agency.
事实构成了侵权逆占（adverse possession），相关部分土地的所有权已归属于该机构。

B. The interest of the public in the conversion of waste to energy overrides the son's entitlement to equitable remedies.
公众在垃圾转化为能源方面的利益，优先于儿子获得衡平法救济的权利。

C. The man's failure to keep himself informed as to the agency's use of his land and his failure to object constituted implied consent to the continuation of that use.
该男子未能了解其土地被该机构使用的情况且未能提出反对，构成了对继续该使用的默示同意。

D. The power of eminent domain of the state makes the son's claim moot.
州的征用权让儿子的主张失去了实际意义。
data.explanation:
A person may acquire title to another's land by adverse possession if his/her possession of the land is:

  • O pen and notorious - apparent or visible to a reasonable owner
  • C ontinuous - without substantial interruption for the statutory period (daily/weekly use is not required)
  • E xclusive - not shared with the owner
  • A ctual - physical presence on the portion of the land to be adversely possessed
  • N onpermissive - hostile and adverse to the owner


Here, the agency openly and continuously dumped waste on a portion of the man's land for more than 10 years (the statutory period) without his participation or permission. The four-week period each year during which waste was not being dumped did not invalidate the agency's continuous use of the land. Therefore, title to that portion of the man's land has likely vested in the agency by adverse possession.

(Choice B) Although converting waste to energy has social value, the agency could have reasonably achieved that interest without infringing on the son's ownership rights (eg, by dumping waste on other land in the remote area). As a result, the utility of the agency's activity likely does not override the son's entitlement to equitable remedies.

(Choice C) The man's failure to notice or object to the agency's use of his land did not constitute implied consent to the continuation of that use. Instead, his failure to notice or object within the 10-year statutory period allowed the agency to acquire title to a portion of his land through adverse possession.

(Choice D) Eminent domain prohibits the government from taking private property for public use without just compensation. Since there is no evidence that the governmental agency compensated the man or his son for its use of the land, there is a live controversy (ie, the son's claim is not moot).

Educational objective: Adverse possession allows one to acquire title to any portion of another's land that he/she possesses in an open and notorious, continuous, exclusive, actual, and non-permissive manner (OCEAN).



选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 7%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一个人可以通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得他人土地的所有权，如果其对土地的占有是：

  • 公开且众所周知（Open and notorious） - 对理性的所有者而言是明显或可见的
  • 持续（Continuous） - 在法定时效期间内无实质性中断（不要求每日/每周使用）
  • 排他性（Exclusive） - 未与所有者共享
  • 实际占有（Actual） - 对将被侵权逆占的部分土地有实体存在
  • 非经许可（Nonpermissive） - 对所有者具有敌意和对抗性


在本案中，该机构在超过10年（法定时效期间）的时间里，未经该男子参与或许可，公开且持续地在该男子土地的一部分倾倒垃圾。每年为期四周没有倾倒垃圾的期间，并未使该机构对土地的持续使用无效。因此，该部分土地的所有权很可能已通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）归属于该机构。

（选项 B）尽管垃圾转化为能源具有社会价值，但该机构本可以通过不侵犯儿子所有权的方式合理地实现该利益（例如，在偏远地区的其他土地上倾倒垃圾）。因此，该机构活动的好处很可能不会优先于儿子获得衡平法救济的权利。

（选项 C）该男子未能注意到或反对该机构对其土地的使用，并不构成对继续该使用的默示同意。相反，他在10年法定时效期间内未能注意到或提出反对，使得该机构得以通过侵权逆占（adverse possession）获得其部分土地的所有权。

（选项 D）征用权（Eminent domain）禁止政府在没有公正补偿的情况下为公共用途征用私人财产。由于没有证据表明政府机构就其使用土地对该男子或儿子进行了补偿，因此存在一个实际的争议（即，儿子的主张并非没有实际意义）。

教学目标：侵权逆占（Adverse possession）允许一个人在以公开且众所周知、持续、排他、实际占有和未经许可的方式（OCEAN）占有他人土地的任何部分时，获得该部分土地的所有权。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Adverse Possession
正确答案：A
⚖️ 核心法则：侵权逆占 (Adverse Possession)

要通过时效占有获得土地所有权，占有必须满足 OCEAN 标准：

  • Open & Notorious (公开且众所周知)
  • Continuous (持续)
  • Exclusive (排他)
  • Actual (实际占有)
  • Non-permissive / Hostile (未经许可/敌意)
🔍 深度解析
1. 持续性 (Continuous) 的认定
这是本题最大的陷阱。题目提到每年有4周时间垃圾堆会被清理掉。
法律规则：“持续”并不意味着 24/7 全天候占有。它要求占有者像一个真正的所有者 (True Owner) 在类似情况下那样使用土地。
本案应用：对于一个垃圾处理厂来说，每年停工维护4周是正常的商业运作模式。这种周期性的中断并没有打破占有的“持续性”。因此，12年的占有满足了10年的法定时效。
2. 边界误解 (Mistake) 与敌意 (Hostile)
题目提到双方都不知道越界了。
法律规则：在大多数司法管辖区（以及MBE考试中），采用客观标准 (Objective Test)。占有者的主观意图（是否知道那是别人的地）通常是不相关的。只要你在没有获得许可的情况下占有了土地，这就构成了“敌意”或“权利主张” (Claim of Right)。
3. 结果
由于机构满足了所有 OCEAN 要素且超过了10年时效，所有权已经自动转移给了机构。既然机构现在是这部分土地的合法所有者，儿子的诉讼自然会失败。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (公共利益)： 虽然法院在决定是否颁发禁令 (Injunction) 时会平衡权益，但本题的关键在于所有权已经发生了转移。一旦 Adverse Possession 成立，机构就是地主，不需要依赖“公共利益”来抗辩。
选项 C (默示同意 Implied Consent)： 这是一个常见的诱导选项。地主的不作为 (Failure to object) 是 Adverse Possession 成立的前提，但这并不等同于法律上的“同意” (Permission)。如果地主真的“同意”了，那就变成了许可 (License)，反而会阻断 Adverse Possession。
选项 D (征用权 Eminent Domain)： 征用权要求政府进行公正补偿 (Just Compensation)。本案中政府只是单纯占有，没有走征收程序也没给钱，所以不能用征用权来解释。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

遇到 Adverse Possession 的题目，请立即检查：

  1. 时间：是否超过法定时效？(本题 12 > 10)
  2. 中断：是否有真正的中断？(正常的季节性使用或维护不算中断)
  3. 政府：通常私人不能逆占政府土地，但政府可以逆占私人土地。

questions.question:
At the time of his death last week, a man owned a small farm. By his duly probated will, drawn five years ago, the man did the following:
1. He devised the farm "to my farmhand for the life of my wife, then to my cousin."
2. He gave "all the rest, residue and remainder of my estate, both real and personal, to my friend."
At his death, the man was survived by a son (his sole heir), the farmhand, the cousin, and the friend. The wife had died a week before the man.
Who has title to the farm?

choices.a: The cousin, in fee simple.
choices.b: The farmhand for life, remainder to the cousin.
choices.c: The friend, in fee simple.
choices.d: The son, in fee simple.

上周，一名男子去世时，他拥有一个小农场。根据他五年前订立并经正式认证的遗嘱，该男子作了如下安排：

1. 他将农场遗赠“给我的农场雇工，以我妻子的生命为限，然后归我的堂兄弟。”
2. 他将“我所有剩余、残余及剩余的遗产，包括不动产和动产，全部赠予我的朋友。”

该男子去世时，其在世亲人包括一个儿子（他的唯一继承人）、农场雇工、堂兄弟和朋友。妻子在该男子去世前一周已去世。

谁拥有该农场的所有权？
options:
A. The cousin, in fee simple.
堂兄弟，拥有完全所有权(fee simple)。

B. The farmhand for life, remainder to the cousin.
农场雇工拥有终身权益，剩余权益归堂兄弟。

C. The friend, in fee simple.
朋友，拥有完全所有权(fee simple)。

D. The son, in fee simple.
儿子，拥有完全所有权(fee simple)。
data.explanation:
Doctrines affecting conveyance by will


LapseCauses devise to fail if beneficiary predeceases testator
AdemptionCauses devise to fail by either:
  • extinction - specifically devised property not owned by testator (or destroyed or fundamentally changed) at death
  • satisfaction - beneficiary received devised property (or other asset intended to satisfy devise) during testator's life
ExonerationAllows beneficiary of specifically devised real property to use estate's remaining assets to pay off any encumbrances on that property
AbatementReduces devises that cannot be satisfied by assets remaining after testator's debts are paid. Residuary devises abated first, followed by general & then specific devises.
Lapse (ie, the failure of a gift of property under a will) normally occurs when the beneficiary dies before the testator dies. But when a will gives a life estate pur autre vie - ie, a life estate measured by the life of someone other than the life tenant - lapse occurs when either the life tenant or the measuring life predeceases the testator. The life tenant's (or other measuring life's) predecease affects only the life tenant's interest, however, so any remainder interest is not defeated.

Here, the man's will devised a life estate pur autre vie in the farm to the farmhand (measured by the wife's life) and a remainder to the cousin. Because the wife died before the man, the doctrine of lapse caused the devise to the farmhand to fail. But since the cousin's remainder interest was not defeated by the wife's death, the cousin has title to the farm in fee simple (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: When a will gives a life estate pur autre vie, the devise will lapse (ie, fail) if the life tenant or the measuring life dies before the testator. But the remainder interest, if any, will survive.

选项正确率统计：A选项 84%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 9%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

影响遗嘱转让的法律原则


Lapse (遗赠失效)若受益人先于立遗嘱人去世，则导致遗赠失败
Ademption (遗赠撤销)通过以下任一方式导致遗赠失败：
  • 消灭(extinction) - 特别遗赠的财产在立遗嘱人去世时已不为其所有（或被毁坏、发生根本性改变）
  • 清偿(satisfaction) - 受益人在立遗嘱人生前已获得遗赠财产（或其他旨在清偿该遗赠的资产）
Exoneration (涤除负担)允许特别遗赠的不动产受益人使用遗产中的剩余资产来清偿该财产上的任何负担
Abatement (遗赠减免)当清偿立遗嘱人债务后剩余资产不足以满足所有遗赠时，对遗赠进行削减。首先减免剩余遗赠，其次是一般遗赠，最后是特别遗赠。
Lapse原则（遗赠失效）（即遗嘱中的财产赠与失败）通常发生在受益人先于立遗嘱人去世时。但当遗嘱授予为他人之终身的终身地产权（life estate pur autre vie）——即以终身地产权持有人以外的某人的生命为衡量标准的终身地产权——时，如果终身地产权持有人或衡量生命在立遗嘱人之前去世，则会发生遗赠失效。然而，终身地产权持有人（或其他衡量生命）的先亡只影响终身地产权持有人的权益，因此任何剩余权益都不会被废止。

在本案中，该男子的遗嘱将农场的一份为他人之终身的终身地产权（life estate pur autre vie）遗赠给了农场雇工（以妻子的生命为衡量），并将剩余权益遗赠给了堂兄弟。因为妻子在男子之前去世，Lapse原则导致了对农场雇工的遗赠失败。但由于堂兄弟的剩余权益并未因妻子的去世而被废止，因此堂兄弟拥有该农场的完全所有权(fee simple)（选项 B、C 和 D 错误）。

教学目的：当遗嘱授予为他人之终身的终身地产权(life estate pur autre vie)时，如果终身地产权持有人或衡量生命在立遗嘱人之前去世，该遗赠将会失效（即 fail）。但是，任何剩余权益（如果有的话）将会存续。

References

  • 80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1415 (2019) (death of life tenant before death of testator).
  • Restatement (Second) of Property: Donative Transfers § 34.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1992) (donee dies before donor).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property & Wills (财产法与遗嘱)
核心考点：遗嘱生效时间与权益加速 本题考察的是当衡量生命 (Measuring Life) 在立遗嘱人 (Testator) 去世前终结时，为他人之终身的终身地产权 (Life Estate Pur Autre Vie) 的命运以及剩余权益 (Remainder) 的归属。
关键时间线分析
5年前：男子立下遗嘱。
赠予：农场雇工（期限为妻子在世期间） -> 堂兄弟。
1周前：妻子（衡量生命）去世。
此时遗嘱尚未生效，但衡量该权益期限的人已经不在了。
现在：男子（立遗嘱人）去世。
遗嘱正式生效 (Will speaks at death)。
法律推理逻辑

1. 遗嘱何时生效？
遗嘱是“不确定的” (Ambulatory)，直到立遗嘱人死亡那一刻才生效。因此，我们必须站在男子去世的那一刻来看待财产的分配。

2. 农场雇工的权益 (Life Estate Pur Autre Vie)
遗嘱试图给雇工一个权益，期限是“妻子的生命”。但是，当遗嘱生效时，妻子已经去世了。
这意味着该权益的期限在开始前就已经结束了。因此，给雇工的遗赠发生失效 (Lapse)，或者更准确地说是因期限届满而从未产生。

3. 堂兄弟的权益 (Remainder)
雇工的权益失效，是否意味着整个赠予失败？
否。法律原则是“剩余权益加速” (Acceleration of Remainders)。当先行权益 (Preceding Estate) 因任何原因（如受益人先亡、放弃继承、或如本案中衡量生命结束）而失败时，紧随其后的既得剩余权益 (Vested Remainder) 会立即生效并占有财产。

选项判定
正确 A. 堂兄弟，拥有完全所有权。
由于先行权益（雇工的权益）已经不存在，堂兄弟作为剩余权益持有人，其权益“加速”成为现在的占有权益。因为堂兄弟之后没有其他限制，他获得的是 Fee Simple Absolute。
错误 B. 农场雇工拥有终身权益...
雇工的权益是以妻子的生命为期限的。妻子已死，雇工的权益自然终止。雇工不能获得一个“已经结束”的权益。
错误 C. 朋友 (剩余财产受益人)...
只有当具体的遗赠完全失败（Lapse）且没有替代者时，财产才会落入剩余遗产 (Residuary Estate)。这里虽然雇工没拿到，但堂兄弟的剩余权益是有效的，所以农场不会落入剩余遗产。
错误 D. 儿子 (法定继承人)...
只有在遗嘱未处置该财产（Intestacy）时，法定继承人才有份。本案中遗嘱有效处置了农场给堂兄弟。
💡 MBE 提分技巧：
遇到涉及“时间”和“死亡顺序”的题目，务必牢记：
1. 遗嘱只在立遗嘱人死亡时说话 (The Will speaks at death)。在此之前发生的事件（如受益人死亡、财产灭失）会直接改变遗嘱生效时的状态。
2. 如果先行权益（Life Estate）失败，直接检查是否有剩余权益（Remainder）。如果有，通常直接让剩余权益人“插队”上位（Acceleration）。

questions.question:
Five years ago, an investor who owned a vacant lot in a residential area borrowed $25,000 from a friend and gave the friend a note for $25,000 due in five years, secured by a mortgage on the lot. The friend neglected to record the mortgage. The fair market value of the lot was then $25,000.
Three years ago, the investor discovered that the friend had not recorded his mortgage and in consideration of $50,000 conveyed the lot to a buyer. The fair market value of the lot was then $50,000. The buyer knew nothing of the friend's mortgage. One month thereafter, the friend discovered the sale to the buyer, recorded his $25,000 mortgage, and notified the buyer that he held a $25,000 mortgage on the lot.
Two years ago, the buyer needed funds. Although she told her bank about the mortgage claimed by the investor's friend, the bank loaned her $15,000, and she gave the bank a note for $15,000 due in two years secured by a mortgage on the lot. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage. At that time, the fair market value of the lot was $75,000.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
Both notes are now due, and both the investor and the buyer have refused to pay. The lot is now worth only $50,000.
What are the rights of the investor's friend and the bank in the lot?

choices.a: Both mortgages are enforceable liens, and the friend's has priority because it was first recorded.
choices.b: Both mortgages are enforceable liens, but the bank's has priority because the buyer was an innocent purchaser for value.
choices.c: Only the bank's mortgage is an enforceable lien, because the buyer was an innocent purchaser for value.
choices.d: Only the friend's mortgage is an enforceable lien, because the bank had actual and constructive notice of the investor's fraud.

五年前，一位在住宅区拥有一块空地的投资者从一位朋友处借款25,000美元，并向该朋友出具了一张五年后到期的、金额为25,000美元的本票，并以该地块的抵押权作为担保。该朋友疏于登记该抵押权。当时，该地块的公平市场价值为25,000美元。

三年前，该投资者发现其朋友并未登记其抵押权，遂以50,000美元为对价将该地块转让给一位买方。当时，该地块的公平市场价值为50,000美元。该买方对朋友的抵押权毫不知情。一个月后，该朋友发现了此次向买方的出售行为，登记了他25,000美元的抵押权，并通知买方他对此地块拥有25,000美元的抵押权。

两年前，该买方需要资金。尽管她告知了银行投资者朋友所主张的抵押权，银行仍向她贷款15,000美元，她也向银行出具了一张两年后到期、金额为15,000美元的本票，并以该地块的抵押权作为担保。银行立即登记了该抵押权。当时，该地块的公平市场价值为75,000美元。

该司法管辖区的登记法案规定：“任何不动产的转让或抵押，除非已依法登记，否则对后续的有偿且善意的受让人无效。”

如今，两张本票均已到期，投资者和买方都拒绝支付。该地块现仅值50,000美元。

投资者的朋友和银行在该地块上分别拥有什么权利？
options:
A. Both mortgages are enforceable liens, and the friend's has priority because it was first recorded.
两项抵押权均为可强制执行的担保权，且朋友的抵押权因其登记在先而具有优先权。

B. Both mortgages are enforceable liens, but the bank's has priority because the buyer was an innocent purchaser for value.
两项抵押权均为可强制执行的担保权，但银行的抵押权因买方是善意有偿受让人而具有优先权。

C. Only the bank's mortgage is an enforceable lien, because the buyer was an innocent purchaser for value.
只有银行的抵押权是可强制执行的担保权，因为买方是善意有偿受让人。

D. Only the friend's mortgage is an enforceable lien, because the bank had actual and constructive notice of the investor's fraud.
只有朋友的抵押权是可强制执行的担保权，因为银行对投资者的欺诈行为有实际和推定的知晓。
data.explanation:
Recording acts determine the priority of competing interests in the same property. Most recording acts protect bona fide purchasers (BFPs or innocent purchasers for value) - ie, persons or entities who:
  • pay value for an interest in property and
  • lack notice of a prior interest in the property.


In a jurisdiction with a notice recording act (as seen here), a BFP's property interest is always superior to an earlier competing property interest of which the BFP lacked notice. And under the Shelter Rule , a person who receives a property interest from a BFP is entitled to the same protection under the recording act as the BFP. This ultimately protects the BFP by ensuring that the BFP receives the full benefit of the purchase and is able to convey an interest in the property.

Here, the buyer was a BFP because she knew nothing of the friend's prior unrecorded mortgage when the investor sold her the vacant lot. The buyer therefore had priority under the jurisdiction's notice act and took the lot free of the friend's mortgage. The buyer then mortgaged the lot to the bank. And although the buyer told the bank about the friend's prior mortgage (ie, the bank was not a BFP), the Shelter Rule entitles the bank to the buyer's protection under the recording act. As a result, only the bank has an enforceable mortgage on the lot (Choices A, B & D).

Educational objective: Under the Shelter Rule, a person who receives a property interest from a bona fide purchaser (BFP) is entitled to the same protection under the jurisdiction's recording act as the BFP.



选项正确率统计：A选项 30%，B选项 19%，C选项 37%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

登记法案决定了同一财产上相互冲突的权益的优先顺序。大多数登记法案保护善意购买者 (bona fide purchasers, BFP，或称善意有偿受让人)，即符合以下条件的个人或实体：
  • 为财产权益支付对价 并且
  • 对该财产上存在的先前权益不知情。


在一个采用通知型登记法案 (notice recording act) 的司法管辖区（如此处所示），BFP的财产权益总是优先于BFP所不知情的、在先的竞合财产权益。并且，根据庇护规则 (Shelter Rule)，从BFP处获得财产权益的人，有权根据登记法案获得与该BFP相同的保护。这最终通过确保BFP获得其购买的全部利益并能够转让其财产权益来保护BFP。

在此案中，买方是一位BFP，因为在投资者向她出售空地时，她对朋友先前未登记的抵押权一无所知。因此，根据该司法管辖区的通知型法案，买方享有优先权，并取得了不受朋友抵押权约束的地块所有权。随后，买方将地块抵押给银行。尽管买方告知了银行关于朋友先前抵押权的事（即银行不是BFP），但庇护规则 (Shelter Rule) 使银行有权获得买方在登记法案下的保护。因此，只有银行对该地块拥有可强制执行的抵押权（选项A、B和D错误）。

教学目标：根据庇护规则 (Shelter Rule)，从善意购买者 (BFP) 处获得财产权益的人，有权根据该司法管辖区的登记法案获得与该BFP相同的保护。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts
核心考点：庇护规则 (The Shelter Rule) 在不动产登记法中，如果一个人从善意购买人 (Bona Fide Purchaser, BFP) 处受让财产，那么无论该受让人自己是否知情，他都将继承 BFP 在登记法下的保护地位。

本题考察的是在一个通知型法案 (Notice Statute) 管辖区内，未登记抵押权、善意购买人与后续受让人之间的权利顺位问题。

1
确定法案类型
题目中的法案规定：“除非依法登记，否则...对后续善意有偿 (for value and without notice) 的购买者无效。”
"No conveyance... shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless..."
这属于典型的 Notice Statute (通知型法案)。在此类法案下，只要后续购买者在购买时是善意的（不知情），他就优先于先前的未登记权益。
2
买方 (Buyer) 的地位
  • 买方支付了 $50,000 (for value)。
  • 买方购买时，朋友的抵押权未登记。
  • 买方对抵押权毫不知情 (without notice)。

因此，买方是标准的 BFP。根据通知型法案，买方取得了该地块的完整所有权，朋友的抵押权对买方无效 (extinguished)。

3
银行 (Bank) 的地位与庇护规则
买方随后将地块抵押给银行。虽然银行在放贷时实际上知晓 (actual notice) 朋友的抵押权（因为买方告诉了银行），但这并不影响银行的优先权。

这里适用 Shelter Rule (庇护规则)：
银行从 BFP (买方) 处获得权益。为了保护 BFP 能够自由处分其财产的权利，法律允许 BFP 将其“干净”的产权转移给任何人（即使受让人知情）。

结论：银行“躲在”买方的保护伞下，继承了买方对抗朋友抵押权的优先地位。

综上所述，朋友的抵押权在买方购买时已被切断，不再附着于该土地。银行的抵押权则因庇护规则而有效。

正确答案：C

只有银行的抵押权是可强制执行的担保权，因为买方是善意有偿受让人 (BFP)，且银行继承了其地位。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • 选项 A & B (Both enforceable): 错误。一旦买方作为 BFP 取得产权，朋友未登记的抵押权就被“清洗”掉了。它不再是该土地上的有效留置权 (Lien)。朋友只能向投资者追偿债务，无法执行抵押权。
  • 选项 D (Only friend's): 错误。虽然银行知情，但根据 Shelter Rule，银行的知情无关紧要，因为它的权利源自一个不知情的 BFP。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 "Transferee from a BFP" (从 BFP 处受让的人) 时，立刻联想 Shelter Rule。

即使受让人知道先前的欺诈或未登记权益，只要他不是欺诈的参与者，他就能继承 BFP 的“免疫力”。这是为了确保 BFP 能够顺利将财产变现（否则如果全世界都知道了瑕疵，BFP 就卖不出去了）。

questions.question:
A large corporation owned property in fee simple, as the real estate records showed. The corporation entered into a valid written contract to convey the property to a shareholder. At closing, the shareholder paid the price in full and received an instrument in the proper form of a deed, signed by duly authorized corporate officers on behalf of the corporation, purporting to convey the property to the shareholder. The shareholder did not then record the deed or take possession of the property.
Next, a creditor (who had no knowledge of the contract or the deed) obtained a substantial money judgment against the corporation. Then, the shareholder recorded the deed from the corporation. Thereafter, the creditor properly filed the judgment against the corporation.
A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
Afterward, the shareholder entered into a valid written contract to convey the property to a local businessman. The businessman objected to the shareholder's title and refused to close.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "Unless the same be recorded according to law, no conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice."
The shareholder brought an appropriate action to require the businessman to complete the purchase contract.
For whom should the court decide?

choices.a: The businessman, because even though the corporation's deed to the shareholder prevented the creditor's judgment from being a lien on the property, the creditor's filed judgment poses a threat of litigation.
choices.b: The businessman, because the creditor's judgment was obtained before the shareholder recorded the deed from the corporation.
choices.c: The shareholder, because the shareholder received the deed from the corporation before the creditor filed his judgment.
choices.d: The shareholder, because the shareholder recorded her deed before the creditor filed his judgment.

The shareholder brought an appropriate action to require the businessman to complete the purchase contract.

For whom should the court decide?

一家大公司以 fee simple（完全所有权）的形式拥有一处房产，如房地产记录所示。该公司签订了一份有效的书面合同，将该房产转让给一名股东。在过户时，股东全额支付了价款，并收到了一份格式正确的契约文书，该文书由公司正式授权的管理人员代表公司签署，意图将房产转让给该股东。当时，该股东并未登记该契约，也未占有该房产。

接下来，一名债权人（对该合同或契约毫不知情）获得了针对该公司的一项大额金钱判决。然后，该股东登记了从公司处获得的契约。此后，该债权人妥善地备案了针对该公司的判决。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何妥善备案的判决，自备案之日起十年内，均构成对判决对象当时拥有或此后获得的房产的留置权。”

之后，该股东签订了一份有效的书面合同，将该房产转让给一名本地商人。该商人对股东的产权提出了异议，并拒绝完成过户。

该司法管辖区的登记法规定：“除非依法登记，否则任何房产的转让或抵押，对于善意且无通知的有偿后续购买者，均不具有效力。”

该股东提起了适当的诉讼，要求该商人履行购买合同。

法院应判决谁胜诉？
options:
A. The businessman, because even though the corporation's deed to the shareholder prevented the creditor's judgment from being a lien on the property, the creditor's filed judgment poses a threat of litigation.
应判决商人胜诉，因为即使公司向股东转让的契约阻止了债权人的判决成为房产上的留置权，债权人已备案的判决仍然构成了诉讼威胁。

B. The businessman, because the creditor's judgment was obtained before the shareholder recorded the deed from the corporation.
应判决商人胜诉，因为债权人的判决是在股东登记公司契约之前获得的。

C. The shareholder, because the shareholder received the deed from the corporation before the creditor filed his judgment.
应判决股东胜诉，因为股东在债权人备案其判决之前，就已经从公司处收到了契约。

D. The shareholder, because the shareholder recorded her deed before the creditor filed his judgment.
应判决股东胜诉，因为股东在债权人备案其判决之前，就已经登记了她的契约。
data.explanation:
A money judgment is a court order awarding the plaintiff (ie, creditor) a sum of money that the defendant (ie, debtor) must pay. A judgment lien is created when the creditor obtains a money judgment against the debtor and the money judgment is properly filed in the land records (majority rule).

Once a judgment lien is created, it attaches to the debtor's property and (1) prevents the owner from conveying marketable title and (2) remains with the property even if it is later conveyed to another. However, the lien can only attach to property owned by the debtor at the time the lien is filed.

Here, the creditor filed his judgment against the corporation after the shareholder had received the deed from the corporation - ie, when the corporation no longer owned the property. As a result, the judgment lien did not attach to the property, and the shareholder can convey marketable title. The court should therefore find in her favor and require the businessman to specifically perform the purchase contract.

  • (Choice A) A threat of litigation renders title unmarketable if a third party (eg, the creditor) could reasonably claim a superior interest in the buyer's property. Since the corporation's deed to the shareholder prevented the creditor's subsequent judgment from being a lien on the property, the creditor has no interest in the property. Therefore, though the creditor's filed judgment may pose a threat of litigation, the shareholder can convey marketable title.
  • (Choice B) The creditor's judgment would have attached to the property only if it had been filed before the shareholder received her deed. The fact that it was obtained before she recorded her deed is immaterial.
  • (Choice D) Recording is not required to transfer an interest in property. And since the property transferred to the shareholder when she received her deed (before the judgment was filed), she will prevail on that basis instead.

Educational objective: A properly filed judgment lien attaches to the debtor's property. The lien prevents the owner from conveying marketable title and remains with the property even if it is later conveyed to another. But a judgment lien can only attach to property owned by the debtor at the time the judgment lien is filed.



选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 11%，C选项 26%（正确选项），D选项 32%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

金钱判决是法院命令，裁定原告（即债权人）获得一笔金钱，而被告（即债务人）必须支付。当债权人获得针对债务人的金钱判决并且该金钱判决在土地档案中被妥善备案（多数规则）时，判决留置权即告产生。

一旦判决留置权产生，它将附着于债务人的财产上，并且 (1) 阻止所有者转让可售产权，(2) 即使财产后来被转让给他人，留置权仍然存在于该财产上。然而，留置权只能附着于债务人在留置权备案之时所拥有的财产上。

在本案中，债权人备案其针对公司的判决是在股东收到公司契约之后——即，在公司不再拥有该房产之时。因此，判决留置权并未附着于该房产上，股东可以转让可售产权。因此，法院应作出有利于她的判决，并要求商人具体履行购买合同。

  • (选项 A) 如果第三方（例如，债权人）可以合理地主张对购买者房产的优先权益，则诉讼威胁会使产权变为不可售。由于公司向股东转让的契约阻止了债权人随后的判决成为房产上的留置权，因此债权人对该房产没有权益。因此，尽管债权人已备案的判决可能构成诉讼威胁，但股东仍可以转让可售产权。
  • (选项 B) 债权人的判决只有在股东收到其契约之前备案，才会附着于该房产上。其判决在股东登记契约之前获得这一事实并不重要。
  • (选项 D) 登记并非转让房产权益的必要条件。而且，由于房产在股东收到其契约时（在判决备案之前）已经转让给了她，她将因此而胜诉。

教学目标： 一个妥善备案的判决留置权会附着于债务人的财产上。该留置权阻止所有者转让可售产权，并且即使财产后来被转让给他人，留置权仍然存在于该财产上。但是，判决留置权只能附着于债务人在判决留置权备案之时所拥有的财产上。

References

46 Am. Jur. 2d Judgments § 352 (2018) (priority of judgment liens).

核心考点：判决留置权与产权转移

本题考察的是不动产法中的两个关键概念的交集：

  • 判决留置权 (Judgment Lien) 的附着时间与条件。
  • 产权转让 (Conveyance) 的生效时间。

关键在于理解：债权人只能对债务人实际拥有的财产主张权利。

案件关键时间线

1. 产权转让 (Conveyance)
公司将地契交付给股东。股东支付对价。
法律后果：产权在此刻发生转移。公司不再拥有该房产。
2. 获得判决 (Judgment Obtained)
债权人赢得针对公司的官司。
3. 登记地契 (Recording)
股东在公共记录中登记了地契。
4. 备案判决 (Judgment Filed)
债权人备案判决。
关键点：根据法规，留置权在此刻试图附着。

法律推理与解析

1. 判决留置权的法规解读

题目中的法规明确指出：判决在备案 (Filed) 时，成为对债务人当时拥有 (then owned) 的财产的留置权。

2. 产权何时转移？

在普通法中，有效的地契 (Deed) 一经交付 (Delivery) 给受让人，产权即发生转移。登记 (Recording) 并不是产权在当事人之间转移的必要条件，登记的主要目的是对抗第三人（如后续购买者）。

3. 结合本案事实

当债权人在第4步备案判决时，我们必须问：此时公司还拥有这块地吗？

答案是没有。因为在第1步，公司已经将地契交付给了股东。虽然股东当时没登记，但产权已经离开了公司。

结论：由于在判决备案时，公司已不再拥有该房产，因此判决留置权无法附着 (Attach) 于该房产。股东拥有的是可售产权 (Marketable Title)。

为什么正确答案是 C？

选项 C：股东胜诉，因为股东在债权人备案其判决之前，就已经从公司处收到了契约。

这个选项精准地指出了法律依据：

  • 收到契约 (Received the deed) = 产权转移的时间点。
  • 备案判决 (Filed his judgment) = 留置权试图附着的时间点。

因为前者早于后者，且法规限制留置权仅能附着于债务人拥有的财产，所以留置权无效。

易错项辨析

❌ 选项 A (诉讼威胁)

虽然“诉讼威胁”通常会让产权变得不可售，但前提是该威胁必须是非轻浮的 (Non-frivolous)。在本案中，根据法律事实，债权人的留置权显然不存在。一个毫无根据的法律主张不能作为拒绝履行合同的理由。

❌ 选项 B (获得判决的时间)

这是一个陷阱。题目中的法规明确规定留置权自备案 (Filed) 时产生，而不是自法庭宣判 (Obtained/Rendered) 时产生。因此，获得判决的时间点不具有决定性。

❌ 选项 D (登记的时间)

虽然股东确实在债权人备案前登记了，但这不是她胜诉的根本原因。即使她没有登记，只要她在债权人备案前获得了产权，根据该州的判决留置权法规（仅附着于债务人拥有的财产），她依然能胜诉。此外，判决债权人通常不被视为有偿购买者 (Purchaser for Value)，因此不受登记法 (Recording Act) 的保护。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

1. 区分“购买者”与“债权人”：
在涉及登记法 (Recording Acts) 的题目中，判决债权人 (Judgment Creditor) 通常不是受保护的“购买者” (Purchaser)，除非法规特别说明保护 "Creditors"。他们没有为土地支付对价，只是试图收债。

2. 严格阅读法规文本：
本题的胜负手在于法规中的 "then owned"（当时拥有）。MBE 题目中给出的法规文本通常是解题的唯一依据，不要过度依赖通用的普通法规则而忽略了题目设定的特定法规。

MBE Real Property Review | © 2025

A man decided to give a cabin he owned to his daughter at his death. To accomplish this goal, he delivered to his attorney a deed that fully complied with the applicable statute of frauds and told his attorney to record the deed when he died unless he later gave the attorney instructions to the contrary.
Three weeks after dropping off the deed, the man properly drafted and executed his own will, which left all of his real property to his son.
One year later, the man died, and the attorney immediately recorded the deed. At the time of the man's death, the cabin was titled in his name and he owned no other real property. The daughter and the son now disagree as to who is entitled to ownership of the cabin.
Other than the jurisdiction's statute of frauds and statute of wills, there are no applicable statutes.
Who is entitled to ownership of the cabin?

choices.a: The daughter, because the attorney was, for gift-law purposes, a trustee for the daughter.
choices.b: The daughter, because the deed fully complied with the statute of frauds.
choices.c: The son, because the deed was not delivered to the daughter during the man's lifetime.
choices.d: The son, because the proper execution of the will revoked the earlier gift to the daughter.

data.questionStem:
Q86828 A man decided to give a cabin he owned to his daughter at his death. To accomplish this goal, he delivered to his attorney a deed that fully complied with the applicable statute of frauds and told his attorney to record the deed when he died unless he later gave the attorney instructions to the contrary.

Three weeks after dropping off the deed, the man properly drafted and executed his own will, which left all of his real property to his son.

One year later, the man died, and the attorney immediately recorded the deed. At the time of the man's death, the cabin was titled in his name and he owned no other real property. The daughter and the son now disagree as to who is entitled to ownership of the cabin.

Other than the jurisdiction's statute of frauds and statute of wills, there are no applicable statutes.

Who is entitled to ownership of the cabin? 一名男子决定在他去世时将他拥有的一间小屋赠与他的女儿。为实现此目标，他将一份完全符合适用的《反欺诈法》的地契交付给他的律师，并告诉律师在他去世时登记该地契，除非他后来向律师发出相反的指示。

在交出地契三周后，该男子妥善起草并签署了自己的遗嘱，将他所有的不动产留给了他的儿子。

一年后，该男子去世，律师立即登记了地契。在该男子去世时，小屋登记在他的名下，他没有其他不动产。女儿和儿子现在对谁有权拥有小屋的所有权产生了分歧。

除了该司法管辖区的《反欺诈法》和《遗嘱法》外，没有其他适用的法规。

谁有权拥有小屋的所有权？
options:
A. The daughter, because the attorney was, for gift-law purposes, a trustee for the daughter.
女儿，因为就赠与法而言，律师是女儿的受托人。

B. The daughter, because the deed fully complied with the statute of frauds.
女儿，因为地契完全符合《反欺诈法》。

C. The son, because the deed was not delivered to the daughter during the man's lifetime.
儿子，因为地契在该男子生前没有交付给女儿。

D. The son, because the proper execution of the will revoked the earlier gift to the daughter.
儿子，因为遗嘱的妥善签署撤销了早前对女儿的赠与。
data.explanation:
Presumed delivery of deed


Physical delivery (eg, by hand or mail)
Recording
Unconditional delivery to agent
Grantee obtains possession of deed
A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

delivered – evidenced by the grantor's intent to presently convey ownership to the grantee (ie, the grantor must not retain a right to recover the deed) and
accepted – presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee.

Delivery is presumed if the deed is recorded (ie, filed in official land records). But this presumption can be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not intend to presently transfer ownership. And if the deed is not delivered during the grantor's lifetime, it is void and conveys no interest.

Here, the attorney recorded the deed (presumed delivery). But the man retained the right to recover the deed by instructing the attorney to record it upon the man's death unless he gave instructions to the contrary (presumption rebutted). Therefore, the deed was not delivered to the daughter during his lifetime. And since the deed is void, the son (as the beneficiary under the man's will) is entitled to ownership of the cabin.

(Choice A) Since the man retained a right to recover the deed (no present intent to transfer), the son owns the property. But had the man relinquished that right when he gave the deed to the attorney (intending to presently transfer ownership), the attorney would have been the daughter's trustee—ie, her fiduciary who would have been legally required to hold the deed for her benefit until the man's death.

(Choice B) A deed must comply with the statute of frauds—ie, be in writing and signed by the party to be bound. But to effectively transfer ownership of property, the deed must also be delivered during the grantor's lifetime (and accepted by the grantee).

(Choice D) A properly executed will does not revoke an earlier gift that has been both delivered and accepted. That is because the testator (person who made the will) no longer owns the gifted property at death. Therefore, the son is not entitled to ownership of the cabin on this basis.

Educational objective:

地契的推定交付


实际交付（例如，通过面交或邮寄）
登记
无条件交付给代理人
受让人获得地契的占有
地契是一种文件，一旦满足以下条件，即可将不动产的所有权从所有者（出让人）转移给另一人（受让人）：

交付——由出让人意图立即转让所有权给受让人的证据所证明（即，出让人必须不保留收回地契的权利）以及
接受——当转让对受让人有利时，即推定接受。

如果地契被登记（即，在官方土地记录中存档），则推定交付。但这一推定可以被出让人无意立即转让所有权的证据所推翻。并且，如果地契在出让人有生之年没有交付，则该地契无效，不转让任何权益。

在本案中，律师登记了地契（推定交付）。但该男子保留了收回地契的权利，因为他指示律师在他去世时登记地契，除非他发出相反的指示（推定被推翻）。因此，地契在该男子生前并未交付给女儿。由于地契无效，儿子（作为该男子遗嘱下的受益人）有权拥有小屋的所有权。

（选项 A）由于该男子保留了收回地契的权利（没有立即转让的意图），因此儿子拥有该财产。但如果该男子在将地契交给律师时放弃了该权利（意图立即转让所有权），那么律师就会成为女儿的受托人——即她的信托人，在法律上必须为她的利益持有地契直至该男子去世。

（选项 B）地契必须符合《反欺诈法》——即必须是书面形式，并由受约束方签署。但要有效转让财产所有权，地契还必须在出让人有生之年交付（并由受让人接受）。

（选项 D）一份妥善签署的遗嘱不会撤销一份已经交付并被接受的早期赠与。这是因为立遗嘱人（订立遗嘱的人）在去世时已不再拥有该赠与的财产。因此，儿子不能基于此理由获得小屋的所有权。

教学目标：

To effectively transfer ownership of real property, a deed must be delivered during the
grantor's lifetime (and then accepted by the grantee). There is no delivery if the grantor
retains a right to recover the deed.

MBE 考点解析：不动产法

Real Property Deeds & Delivery
正确答案：C (儿子胜诉)

核心理由：地契（Deed）在出让人（Grantor）生前未能完成有效交付（Delivery），因此赠与无效，房产通过遗嘱由儿子继承。

核心考点：地契的交付 (Delivery of Deed)

在美国不动产法中，地契要生效，必须满足两个核心条件：

  1. Donative Intent (赠与意图)：出让人必须有意图立即转移权益（即使占有权推迟到未来）。
  2. Delivery (交付)：出让人必须通过行为表明他已放弃对地契的控制权。

关键规则：如果出让人保留了收回地契的权利（Right to Recover/Recall），则视为没有交付。

本案中的法律关系图解
父亲
(Grantor)
保留撤销权 ❌ ➔
律师
(Agent)
律师仅作为父亲的代理人，而非独立的托管人。
父亲去世时，代理关系终止，地契失效。
深度解析：为什么交付失败？
1
有条件的指令：父亲告诉律师“除非我另有指示，否则在我死后登记”。
2
控制权未丧失：这句话意味着父亲随时可以改变主意收回地契。只要出让人还能把地契拿回来，法律就认为地契还在他手里。
3
代理人 vs. 托管人：因为父亲保留了控制权，律师在法律上被视为父亲的代理人 (Agent)，而不是为女儿持有地契的托管人 (Escrow Agent)。
4
结果：地契从未“离开”父亲的控制范围。当父亲去世时，未交付的地契变成废纸。房产属于遗产的一部分，根据遗嘱（Will）传给儿子。
干扰项排除
选项 A 错误： 律师不是受托人（Trustee）。如果父亲是无条件地将地契交给律师（例如：“拿着这个，我死后给女儿，我不拿回来了”），那么律师才是为女儿利益持有的托管人/受托人，那样交付才有效。本案中的“除非另有指示”破坏了这一点。
选项 B 错误： 仅符合《反欺诈法》（Statute of Frauds）是不够的。反欺诈法只要求书面和签字，但不动产转移必须同时满足交付 (Delivery) 要求。
选项 D 错误： 逻辑顺序错误。遗嘱并没有“撤销”赠与，因为赠与从未发生。如果赠与已经有效交付，遗嘱是无法撤销已完成的赠与的。这里是因为赠与本身无效，所以才轮到遗嘱发挥作用。
MBE 解题技巧：在涉及向第三方（如律师）交付地契的题目中，
永远寻找出让人是否保留了“拿回地契的权利”。
保留权利 = 无交付。

questions.question:
Fifteen years ago, two men who were fishing buddies moved onto vacant rural land owned by a woman they didn't know and built a small fishing shack on it. Twelve years ago, the men replaced the shack with a fish processing plant and a commercial fishing boat dock. The men maintained their commercial fishery operation on the land until one of them died intestate last year, leaving a sole heir.
The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
The woman has now become aware of the changes that have occurred on the land.
In an action to determine title, for whom should the court decide?

choices.a: The man who is still alive and the deceased man's heir, because the men acquired title as tenants in common.
choices.b: The man who is still alive, because he is the surviving adverse possessor.
choices.c: The woman, because the use was changed by the men while they were in possession.
choices.d: The woman, because title cannot be claimed by two adverse possessors simultaneously.

Q86805 Fifteen years ago, two men who were fishing buddies moved onto vacant rural land owned by a woman they didn't know and built a small fishing shack on it. Twelve years ago, the men replaced the shack with a fish processing plant and a commercial fishing boat dock. The men maintained their commercial fishery operation on the land until one of them died intestate last year, leaving a sole heir.

The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

The woman has now become aware of the changes that have occurred on the land.

In an action to determine title, for whom should the court decide? 十五年前，两名互为钓友的男子搬到了一块他们不认识的女子所拥有的空置乡村土地上，并在上面建造了一个小小的钓鱼小屋。十二年前，这两名男子将小屋改建成一个鱼类加工厂和一个商用渔船码头。他们在这块土地上一直经营着他们的商业渔业，直到其中一人于去年无遗嘱死亡，留下一个唯一继承人。

该司法管辖区通过时效占有获得产权的法定时效为10年。

该女子现在已经意识到土地上发生的变化。

在一场产权确认之诉中，法院应为谁做出裁决？
options:
A. The man who is still alive and the deceased man's heir, because the men acquired title as tenants in common.
在世的男子和已故男子的继承人，因为这两名男子以按份共有人的身份取得了产权。

B. The man who is still alive, because he is the surviving adverse possessor.
在世的男子，因为他是存活的时效占有人。

C. The woman, because the use was changed by the men while they were in possession.
该女子，因为这两名男子在占有期间改变了土地的用途。

D. The woman, because title cannot be claimed by two adverse possessors simultaneously.
该女子，因为两名时效占有人不能同时主张产权。

Types of concurrent estates
(real property owned by two or more persons)


Creation languageSuccession of interest
Tenancy in
common†		"To A and B"

Joint tenancy"To A and B as joint tenants with the
right of survivorship"		Right of survivorship

entirety		"To A and B as husband and wife"

survivorship
†Presumed unless creation language states otherwise

An adverse possessor can acquire title to land owned by another if his/her possession of the land is:

Open and notorious – apparent or visible to a reasonable owner Continuous – uninterrupted for the statutory period Exclusive - not shared with the owner Actual - physical presence on the land Non-permissive – hostile and adverse to the owner

When land is adversely possessed by two or more persons, the possessors acquire a concurrent ownership interest as tenants in common. Since a tenancy in common has no right of survivorship, a co-tenant's ownership interest will pass to his/her heirs if the co-tenant dies intestate (ie, without a will).

Here, the two men moved onto the land without the woman's permission or participation, opened a fishing operation, and continuously remained on the property for the 10-year statutory period (Choice D). As a result, the men divested the woman of title through adverse possession and became co-tenants in common. Since one of the men later died intestate, his concurrent ownership interest passed to his sole heir. Therefore, the living man and the sole heir own the land as tenants in common.

(Choice B) The living man would have acquired sole ownership of the property upon the other man's death if the men had a joint tenancy—a concurrent ownership interest with the right of survivorship. But since the men only acquired a tenancy in common (no right of survivorship) by adverse possession, the deceased man's interest passed to his sole heir— not the surviving adverse possessor.

(Choice C) To satisfy the continuous-use requirement, an adverse possessor must (1) constantly remain on the property or (2) consistently use the property in the same manner a usual owner would—eg, seasonal use of a hunting cabin, intermittent use for grazing cattle. Here, the men constantly remained on the property, so it does not matter that their use of the property changed.

Educational objective: When two or more persons adversely possess the land of another, they acquire a tenancy in common—a concurrent ownership interest with no right of survivorship.

共有财产类型
（两人或多人共有的不动产）


设立语言权益继承
按份共有†“给A和B”

“给A和B作为按份共有人”		无遗属权
联权共有“给A和B作为享有遗属权的
联权共有人”		遗属权
整体共有“给A和B作为夫妻”

“给A和B作为整体共有人”		不可摧毁的
遗属权
†除非设立语言另有说明，否则推定成立

时效占有人可以取得他人拥有的土地产权，如果其对土地的占有是：

公开和众所周知 – 对一个理性的所有者来说是明显或可见的 持续性 – 在法定时效内不间断 排他性 - 不与所有者共享 实际占有 - 实际存在于土地上 非经许可 – 对所有者具有敌意和对抗性

当土地被两人或多人时效占有时，占有人以按份共有人的身份获得共有权益。由于按份共有没有遗属权，如果一个共有人无遗嘱死亡（即，没有立遗嘱），其所有权权益将转移给其继承人。

在本案中，这两名男子未经该女子许可或参与，搬到了这片土地上，开设了渔业经营，并持续在该地产上停留超过了10年的法定时效期（选项D）。因此，这两名男子通过时效占有剥夺了该女子的产权，并成为按份共有人。由于其中一名男子后来无遗嘱死亡，他的共有权益转移给了他的唯一继承人。因此，在世的男子和唯一继承人以按份共有人的形式共同拥有这片土地。

(选项B) 如果这两名男子是联权共有——一种带有遗属权的共有权益形式，那么在另一名男子死亡后，在世的男子本可以获得该财产的唯一所有权。但由于他们通过时效占有仅获得了按份共有（无遗属权），已故男子的权益转移给了他的唯一继承人，而不是存活的时效占有人。

(选项C) 为满足持续使用的要求，时效占有人必须(1)持续停留在该地产上，或(2)以一个通常所有者会使用的方式持续使用该地产——例如，季节性使用狩猎小屋，间歇性用于放牧。在本案中，这两名男子持续停留在该地产上，所以他们对地产的用途是否改变无关紧要。

教学目的： 当两人或多人时效占有他人土地时，他们获得的是按份共有——一种没有遗属权的共有权益。

References

Restatement (First) of Property § 65 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (creation of tenancy in common).

Restatement (First) of Property §§ 12–13 (Am. Law Inst. 1936) (transferring and devising a property interest).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property | Adverse Possession

核心考点：多人时效占有

本题考察的是当两人共同完成时效占有 (Adverse Possession) 后，他们所获得的产权性质是什么。

结论：如果不具备特定的法律语言或意图，多人共同时效占有获得的产权默认为按份共有 (Tenancy in Common)。

逻辑推演步骤
第一步：是否获得产权？
占有15年 > 法定10年
Statutory Period Met
↓
第二步：产权性质为何？
默认为按份共有
Tenancy in Common
↓
第三步：一方死亡后归谁？
无遗属权 (No Right of Survivorship)
份额归继承人 (Heir)
深度解析

1. 为什么是按份共有 (Tenancy in Common)?

在美国财产法中，联权共有 (Joint Tenancy) 具有“遗属权” (Right of Survivorship)，即一方死亡，其份额自动归幸存者所有。但这通常需要明确的法律文书（如地契）声明，并满足“四个统一” (Four Unities: Time, Title, Interest, Possession)。

时效占有是基于事实行为获得的产权，缺乏建立联权共有所需的明确意图表达。因此，法院推定适用最基础的共有形式——按份共有。

2. 为什么不是选项 B (存活者独占)?

选项 B 描述的是联权共有 (Joint Tenancy) 的特征。由于本案中两人仅建立了按份共有关系，死者的份额不会自动转移给生者，而是根据无遗嘱继承法流转给其继承人。

3. 为什么原房主 (Woman) 败诉?

时效期为10年，两人已占有15年。产权在第10年结束时就已经从原房主手中转移给了占有人。之后的土地用途改变或其中一人死亡，都不会让产权“回流”给原房主。

MBE 避坑指南
  • 默认规则： 只要题目没有提到“带有遗属权的联权共有” (Joint Tenancy with Right of Survivorship) 的明确语言，多人共有几乎总是按份共有。
  • 时间点： 注意占有时间是否超过法定时效。一旦超过，产权即刻转移 (Title vests immediately)，后续事件（如死亡、搬离）仅影响新产权人之间的关系，原房主已无权干涉。
  • 用途变更： 只要用途符合该类土地的常规使用方式，中途改变具体用途（从小屋变工厂）通常不中断“持续性” (Continuity)。

questions.question:
A woman owned a tract of land in fee simple. By warranty deed, she conveyed the land in fee simple to her brother for a recited consideration of "$10 and other valuable consideration." The deed was promptly and properly recorded.
One week later, the woman and her brother executed a written document that stated that the conveyance of the land was for the purpose of establishing a trust for the benefit of the woman's grandson. The brother expressly accepted the trust and signed the document with the woman. This written agreement was not authenticated to be eligible for recordation and there never was an attempt to record it. The brother entered into possession of the land and distributed the net income from the land to the grandson at appropriate intervals.
Five years later, the brother conveyed the land in fee simple to an investor by warranty deed. The investor paid the fair market value of the land, had no knowledge of the written agreement between the woman and the brother, and entered into possession of the land. The grandson made demand upon the investor for distribution of income at the next usual time the brother would have distributed. The investor refused.
The grandson brought an appropriate action against the investor for a decree requiring her to perform the trust the brother had theretofore recognized.
Which party is likely to prevail?

choices.a: The grandson, because a successor in title to the trustee takes title subject to the grantor's trust.
choices.b: The grandson, because equitable interests are not subject to the recording act.
choices.c: The investor, because, as a bona fide purchaser, she took free of the trust encumbering the brother's title.
choices.d: The investor, because no trust was ever created since the woman had no title at the time of the purported creation.

data.questionStem:
Q86227

A woman owned a tract of land in fee simple. By warranty deed, she conveyed the land in fee simple to her brother for a recited consideration of "$10 and other valuable consideration." The deed was promptly and properly recorded.

One week later, the woman and her brother executed a written document that stated that the conveyance of the land was for the purpose of establishing a trust for the benefit of the woman's grandson. The brother expressly accepted the trust and signed the document with the woman. This written agreement was not authenticated to be eligible for recordation and there never was an attempt to record it. The brother entered into possession of the land and distributed the net income from the land to the grandson at appropriate intervals.

Five years later, the brother conveyed the land in fee simple to an investor by warranty deed. The investor paid the fair market value of the land, had no knowledge of the written agreement between the woman and the brother, and entered into possession of the land. The grandson made demand upon the investor for distribution of income at the next usual time the brother would have distributed. The investor refused.

The grandson brought an appropriate action against the investor for a decree requiring her to perform the trust the brother had theretofore recognized.

Which party is likely to prevail?

一位女士以完全保有地权(fee simple)的形式拥有一块土地。她通过一份担保契约(warranty deed)，以“10美元及其他有价对价(valuable consideration)”的名义，将该土地的完全保有地权(fee simple)转让给了她的兄弟。该契约被及时且适当地登记备案。

一周后，该女士和她的兄弟签署了一份书面文件，声明转让该土地的目的是为该女士的孙子设立一项信托。该兄弟明确接受了该信托，并与该女士共同签署了该文件。这份书面协议未经认证，不符合登记备案的资格，且从未尝试进行登记备案。该兄弟占有了该土地，并定期将土地的净收入分配给孙子。

五年后，该兄弟通过一份担保契约(warranty deed)将该土地的完全保有地权(fee simple)转让给了一位投资者。该投资者支付了该土地的公平市场价值，对该女士和其兄弟之间的书面协议毫不知情，并占有了该土地。在下一次兄弟通常会分配收入的时间，孙子向该投资者要求分配收入。投资者拒绝了。

孙子对该投资者提起了适当的诉讼，要求法院颁布法令，强制其履行其兄弟此前所承认的信托。

哪一方可能会胜诉？
options:
A. The grandson, because a successor in title to the trustee takes title subject to the grantor's trust.
孙子会胜诉，因为受托人的所有权继承人取得所有权时，须受限于设保人的信托。

B. The grandson, because equitable interests are not subject to the recording act.
孙子会胜诉，因为衡平法上的权益不受登记法案的约束。

C. The investor, because, as a bona fide purchaser, she took free of the trust encumbering the brother's title.
投资者会胜诉，因为作为善意购买人(bona fide purchaser)，她取得的所有权不受制于对兄弟所有权的信托负担。

D. The investor, because no trust was ever created since the woman had no title at the time of the purported creation.
投资者会胜诉，因为在声称设立信托时，该女士已无所有权，因此信托从未被设立。
data.explanation:
Types of recording acts


TypeEffectStatutory language
RaceInterest holder who records first will prevail"First record"
NoticeSubsequent BFP without notice of earlier property interest will prevail"Without notice," "In good faith"
Race-NoticeSubsequent BFP (1) without notice of earlier property interest (2) who records first will prevail"Without notice, who shall first record"
BFP = Bona fide purchaser.

Many interests affecting property can be recorded, including trusts affecting land. When different persons own such interests, recording acts are used to evaluate priority of competing interests. Under most recording acts, a subsequent property interest has priority over an earlier interest if the subsequent interest-holder was a bona fide purchaser (BFP) - ie, a person who (1) paid value and (2) lacked notice of the prior interest. There are three types of notice:

  • Actual - when a buyer has direct knowledge of a prior interest
  • Constructive (ie, record) - when a document showing a prior interest was properly recorded in the land records and appears in the buyer's chain of title and
  • Inquiry - when a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property by someone other than the seller).


Here, the investor had no knowledge of the prior trust agreement when she purchased the land from the brother (no actual notice), and the brother's possession of the land gave her no reason to investigate further (no inquiry notice). And since the trust agreement was never recorded, the investor did not have constructive notice of the trust. Therefore, the investor was a BFP and took the land free of the trust.

(Choice A) A successor in title to a trustee does not necessarily take title subject to the trust. And here, since the investor (successor in title) had no notice of the trust when she purchased the land from the brother (trustee), she is not bound by the trust.

(Choice B) Equitable interests affecting property (eg, the grandson's trust) can be recorded and, when they are, give constructive notice to subsequent purchasers.

(Choice D) Although the woman no longer had title to the land when the trust was created, the brother did. Therefore, the trust was valid and enforceable against the brother. But it is not enforceable against the investor - a BFP who lacked notice of the trust when she purchased the land.

Educational objective: Most recording acts protect bona fide purchasers who lacked notice - actual (direct knowledge), constructive (prior recording in chain of title), or inquiry (circumstances warrant investigation) - of a prior competing property interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 4%，C选项 54%（正确选项），D选项 33%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

登记法案的类型


类型效力法定措辞
竞赛型 (Race)首先登记的权益持有人将获胜“首先登记”
通知型 (Notice)对先前财产权益无通知的后续善意购买人将获胜“无通知”、“善意”
竞赛-通知型 (Race-Notice)后续善意购买人 (1) 对先前财产权益无通知且 (2) 首先登记的，将获胜“无通知，且首先登记者”
BFP = 善意购买人 (Bona fide purchaser)。

许多影响财产的权益都可以登记，包括影响土地的信托。当不同的人拥有此类权益时，登记法案 (recording acts) 被用以评估相互竞争的权益的优先次序。根据大多数登记法案，如果后续权益持有人是善意购买人 (bona fide purchaser, BFP)——即 (1) 支付了对价且 (2) 对先前权益缺乏通知 (lacked notice) 的人——则后续财产权益优先于先前权益。通知有三种类型：

  • 实际通知 (Actual) - 买方对先前的权益有直接的了解
  • 推定通知 (Constructive) (即登记通知) - 显示先前权益的文件已在土地记录中妥善登记，并出现在买方的所有权链中并且
  • 查询通知 (Inquiry) - 买方知道或应当知道存在一些情况，这些情况会促使一个理性的人进行调查（例如，除卖方外的其他人对财产的可见使用）。


在本案中，投资者从兄弟处购买土地时对先前的信托协议毫不知情（无实际通知），且兄弟对土地的占有并未使其有理由进行进一步调查（无查询通知）。由于该信托协议从未登记，投资者没有收到关于该信托的推定通知。因此，该投资者是善意购买人(BFP)，其取得的土地不受信托的约束。

(选项A) 受托人的所有权继承人并不必然在受限于信托的情况下取得所有权。在本案中，由于投资者（所有权继承人）在从兄弟（受托人）处购买土地时对信托没有收到通知，因此她不受该信托的约束。

(选项B) 影响财产的衡平法上权益（例如，孙子的信托受益权）可以被登记，一旦登记，即可向后续购买人提供推定通知。

(选项D) 尽管在信托设立时，该女士已不再拥有该土地的所有权，但其兄弟拥有。因此，该信托是有效的，并且可以对该兄弟强制执行。但它对投资者——一个在购买土地时对信托缺乏通知的善意购买人(BFP)——不可强制执行。

教学目标： 大多数登记法案保护那些对先前的竞争性财产权益缺乏通知——实际通知（直接知晓）、推定通知（在所有权链中有过往登记）或查询通知（情况需要调查）——的善意购买人。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：登记法案与信托

本题考察的核心是美国物权法中的善意购买人制度 (Bona Fide Purchaser Doctrine) 以及登记法案 (Recording Acts) 对未登记权益（包括信托）的影响。

核心原则：
如果后续购买者支付了对价 (Value) 且在购买时对先前的权益不知情 (Without Notice)，即成为善意购买人 (BFP)。BFP 通常能切断 (Cut off) 先前未登记的衡平法权益 (Equitable Interests)。

1. 法律关系梳理

  • 原始交易：女士将土地转让给兄弟，契约已登记。兄弟拥有法定所有权 (Legal Title)。
  • 信托设立：一周后签署信托协议，兄弟作为受托人 (Trustee)，孙子作为受益人。孙子拥有衡平法所有权 (Equitable Title)。但该协议未登记 (Unrecorded)。
  • 后续交易：五年后，兄弟将土地卖给投资者。

2. 投资者的身份认定

要确定投资者是否胜诉，必须判断她是否为 BFP。BFP 需满足两个条件：

  1. 支付对价 (Paid Value)：题目明确指出投资者支付了公平市场价值。✅
  2. 无通知 (No Notice)：这是本题的关键。通知分为三种：
通知类型 本案分析
实际通知
Actual Notice		 无。题目称投资者对书面协议“毫不知情”。
推定/记录通知
Constructive/Record Notice		 无。信托协议从未登记，不在所有权链 (Chain of Title) 中。
查询通知
Inquiry Notice		 无。兄弟（卖方）占有土地，这与记录所有权一致，不会引起怀疑。如果孙子占有土地，投资者可能负有查询义务。
由于投资者支付了对价且对信托没有任何形式的通知，她是善意购买人 (BFP)。

3. 结论与判决

根据登记法案（无论是 Notice 类型还是 Race-Notice 类型），BFP 取得的所有权优于先前未登记的权益。

虽然信托在兄弟（受托人）和孙子（受益人）之间是有效的，但由于未登记，它不能对抗不知情的第三方 BFP。因此，投资者取得土地时，该土地不再受孙子的信托权益负担。

正确答案：C (投资者胜诉)

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (孙子胜诉)： 虽然普通法认为受托人的继承人通常受信托约束，但登记法案改变了这一规则。登记法案旨在保护依赖公共记录的购买者。如果权益未登记，BFP 将受到保护。
选项 B (孙子胜诉)： 错误。衡平法权益（如信托、未登记的抵押、地役权）绝对受登记法案的约束。如果它们不登记，就有被 BFP 切断的风险。
选项 D (投资者胜诉，理由错误)： 虽然结果正确，但理由错误。信托是有效设立的。兄弟拥有法定所有权，他有权声明自己为受托人。信托对兄弟有效，只是对投资者无效。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 物权法题目中，看到“未登记的权益” (Unrecorded Interest) 和“后续购买者” (Subsequent Purchaser) 时，立即进行三步检查：

  1. 后续购买者是否支付了对价？
  2. 后续购买者是否有实际知情？
  3. 土地占有情况或公共记录是否提供了任何线索（查询/推定通知）？

如果答案是Yes, No, No，那么后续购买者就是 BFP，通常会胜诉。

questions.question:
Eight years ago, a farmer, prior to moving to a distant city, conveyed his farm to his son by a quitclaim deed. The son paid no consideration. The son, who was 19 years old, without formal education, and without experience in business, took possession of the farm and operated the farm but neglected to record his deed. Subsequently, the farmer conveyed the farm to a friend by warranty deed. The friend, a substantial land and timber promoter, paid valuable consideration for the deed to him. He was unaware of the son's possession, his quitclaim deed, or his relationship to the farmer. The friend promptly and properly recorded his deed and began removing timber from the land. Immediately upon learning of the friend's actions, the son recorded his deed and brought an appropriate action to enjoin the friend from removing the timber and to quiet title in the son.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
In this action, should the friend prevail?

choices.a: No, because the equities favor the son.
choices.b: No, because the son's possession charged the friend with notice.
choices.c: Yes, because a warranty deed for valuable consideration takes priority over a quitclaim deed without consideration.
choices.d: Yes, because the farmer's subsequent conveyance to the friend revoked the gift to the son.

data.questionStem:
Q86228

Eight years ago, a farmer, prior to moving to a distant city, conveyed his farm to his son by a quitclaim deed. The son paid no consideration. The son, who was 19 years old, without formal education, and without experience in business, took possession of the farm and operated the farm but neglected to record his deed. Subsequently, the farmer conveyed the farm to a friend by warranty deed. The friend, a substantial land and timber promoter, paid valuable consideration for the deed to him. He was unaware of the son's possession, his quitclaim deed, or his relationship to the farmer. The friend promptly and properly recorded his deed and began removing timber from the land. Immediately upon learning of the friend's actions, the son recorded his deed and brought an appropriate action to enjoin the friend from removing the timber and to quiet title in the son.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."

In this action, should the friend prevail?

八年前，一位农场主在搬到远方城市之前，通过一份免责契约（quitclaim deed）将其农场转让给了他的儿子。儿子没有支付任何对价。儿子当时19岁，没有受过正规教育，也无商业经验，他占有并经营该农场，但疏于登记其契约。随后，该农场主通过一份担保契约（warranty deed）将农场转让给了一位朋友。这位朋友是一位颇具实力的土地和木材开发商，他为获得该契约支付了有值对价。他对儿子的占有、儿子的免责契约以及儿子与农场主的关系均不知情。这位朋友及时并适当地登记了他的契约，并开始从土地上采伐木材。儿子一得知朋友的行为，便立即登记了他的契约，并提起了适当的诉讼，请求禁止该朋友采伐木材，并确认儿子对土地的所有权（quiet title）。

该司法管辖区的登记法案（recording act）规定：“任何不动产的转让或抵押，除非已依法登记，否则对有偿且善意的后续购买人不具效力。”

在此诉讼中，该朋友应否胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the equities favor the son.
否，因为衡平法上的考量对儿子更有利。

B. No, because the son's possession charged the friend with notice.
否，因为儿子的占有使该朋友被推定知悉。

C. Yes, because a warranty deed for valuable consideration takes priority over a quitclaim deed without consideration.
是，因为有偿的担保契约（warranty deed）优先于无对价的免责契约（quitclaim deed）。

D. Yes, because the farmer's subsequent conveyance to the friend revoked the gift to the son.
是，因为农场主对朋友的后续转让行为撤销了对儿子的赠与。
data.explanation:
Recording acts are used to evaluate the priority of competing property interests. In a notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest has priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP lacked notice.

Here, the farmer gifted his farm to his son. The farmer then sold the farm to his friend. The friend was unaware of the son's prior interest when he purchased the farm (no actual notice), and the son had not recorded his deed at that time (no record notice). But since the son possessed and operated the farm, the friend was charged with inquiry notice of the son's prior interest. Therefore, the son's interest has priority and the friend will not prevail in the quiet title action.

(Choice A) The equities (ie, fairness factors) may favor the son since he was only 19 years old, lacked a formal education, and had no experience in acquiring property. But this information is irrelevant in determining whether his interest or the friend's has priority.

(Choice C) In a notice jurisdiction, a warranty deed for valuable consideration (eg, the friend's deed) only has priority over an earlier quitclaim deed without consideration (eg, the son's deed) if the recipient of the warranty deed lacked notice. Here, the friend had inquiry notice of the son's interest, so the friend will not prevail.

(Choice D) A gift of land is effective once it has been delivered by the grantor and accepted by the grantee (eg, the son). The grantor's subsequent conveyance of the land to a third party (eg, the friend) does not revoke the prior gift. Therefore, the friend will not prevail on this basis.

Educational objective: In a notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser without notice of an earlier property interest will prevail. Inquiry notice exists if a buyer knows, or should know, of circumstances that would prompt a reasonable person to investigate (eg, visible use of the property).



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 46%（正确选项），C选项 37%，D选项 13%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

登记法案 (Recording acts) 用于评估相互冲突的财产权益的优先权。在一个通知型司法管辖区 (notice jurisdiction)（如本案所示），如果善意购买人 (bona fide purchaser, BFP) 善意不知情 (lacked notice)，其财产权益将优先于在先的财产权益。

在本案中，农场主将他的农场赠与了他的儿子。然后，农场主又将农场卖给了他的朋友。该朋友在购买农场时并不知道儿子在先的权益（无实际通知, actual notice），且当时儿子尚未登记其契约（无登记通知, record notice）。但由于儿子占有并经营该农场，朋友被推定负有对儿子在先权益的调查通知（inquiry notice）义务。因此，儿子的权益具有优先权，朋友将在确认产权诉讼（quiet title action）中败诉。

(选项 A) 衡平法上的考量（即公平因素）可能对儿子有利，因为他当时只有19岁，缺乏正规教育，并且在购置财产方面没有经验。但这些信息与确定是他还是朋友的权益具有优先权无关。

(选项 C) 在一个通知型司法管辖区，一份有偿的担保契约（例如，朋友的契约）仅在契约受让人善意不知情的情况下，才优先于一份在先的、无对价的免责契约（例如，儿子的契约）。在本案中，朋友对儿子的权益负有调查通知的义务，因此朋友不会胜诉。

(选项 D) 土地赠与一旦由赠与人（grantor）交付并由受赠人（grantee）（例如，儿子）接受即告生效。赠与人随后将土地转让给第三方（例如，朋友）的行为并不会撤销先前的赠与。因此，朋友不能基于此理由胜诉。

教学目标：在一个通知型司法管辖区，对在先财产权益不知情的善意购买人将会胜诉。如果购买人知道或应当知道某些情况，而这些情况会促使一个理性的人进行调查（例如，对财产的可见使用），则存在调查通知（inquiry notice）。
