data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts
核心考点：调查通知 (Inquiry Notice) 在不动产交易中，购买者不仅需要检查公共记录（Record），还有义务检查房产的实际占有情况。如果有人占有该房产，购买者即被视为知情。
1 识别法规类型 (Identify the Statute)

题目中的法规是典型的 Notice Statute (通知型法案)。规则核心是：后续的善意购买人（BFP）如果购买时不知情 (without notice)，则优先于先前的权益人。

2 分析“通知”的三种形式 (Types of Notice)

朋友要想胜诉，必须证明他在购买时没有任何形式的通知。法律上“通知”分为三种：

  • 实际通知 (Actual Notice): 朋友不知道（题目明确说明）。
  • 登记通知 (Record Notice): 儿子没登记，所以没有。
  • 调查通知 (Inquiry Notice): 关键点！
3 关键事实判定

儿子虽然没有登记，但他占有并经营 (took possession and operated) 该农场。在法律上，土地的实际占有足以构成对全世界的“调查通知”。

这意味着：如果朋友去实地看一眼，就会发现儿子。虽然朋友没去看，但法律推定他应当知道。因此，朋友不属于“不知情”的购买人。

选项详解

正确答案 B 否，因为儿子的占有使该朋友被推定知悉。
这是本题的直接法律依据。占有 (Possession) 产生调查通知 (Inquiry Notice)，破坏了朋友作为善意购买人 (BFP) 的地位。
错误 A 衡平法考量 (Equities)...
虽然儿子年轻且无经验令人同情，但不动产优先权由《登记法案》决定，而非模糊的公平原则。
错误 C 担保契约 vs 免责契约...
这是一个常见的干扰项。契约的类型（Warranty vs Quitclaim）只影响买卖双方的责任，不决定对第三方的优先权。免责契约 (Quitclaim deed) 同样有效转移产权。
错误 D 撤销赠与 (Revoked the gift)...
赠与一旦交付并被接受即完成。赠与人（农场主）后续无法单方面通过卖给别人来撤销之前的有效赠与。
🎓 MBE 考试通关秘籍 遇到 Recording Acts 题目时，请按顺序检查 "AIR"：
  1. Actual Notice (真的知道吗？)
  2. Inquiry Notice (有人住在里面吗？契据里有提到别人吗？)
  3. Record Notice (之前登记了吗？)

只要存在以上任何一种，后续购买人就输了（在 Notice 或 Race-Notice 司法管辖区）。本题死在了 "I" 上。

questions.question:
A man died testate. The man's estate consisted of a residence as well as significant personal property. By his duly probated will, the man devised the residence to a friend, who was specifically identified in the will. The residue of the estate was given to a stated charity.
The man's friend, although alive at the time the man executed the will, had predeceased the man. The friend's wife and their child, who has a disability, both survived the man.
The value of the residence has increased significantly because of recent zoning changes. There is credible extrinsic evidence that the man wanted his friend to own the residence after the man's death so that the friend and his wife could care for their child there.
There is no applicable statute.
If both the charity and the child claim the residence, to whom should the estate distribute the residence?

choices.a: The charity, because the devise to the friend adeemed.
choices.b: The charity, because the devise to the friend lapsed.
choices.c: The child, because extrinsic evidence exists that the man's intent was to benefit the child.
choices.d: The child, because no conditions of survivorship were noted in the will.

data.questionStem:
Q86202

A man died testate. The man's estate consisted of a residence as well as significant personal property. By his duly probated will, the man devised the residence to a friend, who was specifically identified in the will. The residue of the estate was given to a stated charity.

The man's friend, although alive at the time the man executed the will, had predeceased the man. The friend's wife and their child, who has a disability, both survived the man.

The value of the residence has increased significantly because of recent zoning changes. There is credible extrinsic evidence that the man wanted his friend to own the residence after the man's death so that the friend and his wife could care for their child there.

There is no applicable statute.

If both the charity and the child claim the residence, to whom should the estate distribute the residence?

一名男子立有遗嘱去世。该男子的遗产包括一处住宅以及大量个人财产。根据其经正式认证的遗嘱，该男子将该住宅遗赠给了一位在遗嘱中明确指定的朋友。遗产的剩余部分赠予一家指定的慈善机构。

该男子的朋友虽然在男子订立遗嘱时在世，但先于该男子亡故。该朋友的妻子和他们有残疾的孩子在该男子去世后仍然存活。

由于近期的区划变更，该住宅的价值已大幅增加。有可靠的外部证据表明，该男子希望在他去世后由其朋友拥有该住宅，以便朋友和他的妻子可以在那里照顾他们的孩子。

没有适用的成文法。

如果慈善机构和孩子都主张拥有该住宅，遗产应将该住宅分配给谁？
options:
A. The charity, because the devise to the friend adeemed.
慈善机构，因为对朋友的遗赠已撤销(adeemed)。

B. The charity, because the devise to the friend lapsed.
慈善机构，因为对朋友的遗赠已落空(lapsed)。

C. The child, because extrinsic evidence exists that the man's intent was to benefit the child.
孩子，因为有外部证据表明该男子的意图是使孩子受益。

D. The child, because no conditions of survivorship were noted in the will.
孩子，因为遗嘱中没有注明存活条件。
data.explanation:
Doctrines affecting conveyance by will


LapseCauses devise to fail if beneficiary predeceases testator
AdemptionCauses devise to fail by either:
  • extinction - specifically devised property not owned by testator (or destroyed or fundamentally changed) at death
  • satisfaction - beneficiary received devised property (or other asset intended to satisfy devise) during testator's life
ExonerationAllows beneficiary of specifically devised real property to use estate's remaining assets to pay off any encumbrances on that property
AbatementReduces devises that cannot be satisfied by assets remaining after testator's debts are paid. Residuary devises abated first, followed by general & then specific devises.
The man (testator) died testate and left his residence to the friend (beneficiary) under a valid will. However, the doctrine of lapse will cause a devise to fail if the beneficiary dies before the testator (as seen here). In that case, neither the beneficiary nor his/her heirs will acquire the devised property. Instead, it will become part of the general estate and be distributed in accordance with the rest of the will. And if there are no other provisions in the will, the property will be distributed under intestacy laws. But since the man left the residue of his estate to the charity, the estate should distribute the residence to the charity - not the child.

(Choice A) The doctrine of ademption will cause a specific devise to fail if the testator does not own the devised property upon death. But since the man owned the residence when he died, the devise to the friend did not adeem.

(Choice C) Although extrinsic evidence exists that the man's intent was to benefit the child, the parol evidence rule prohibits a court from rewriting a will that lacks significant ambiguities. And since the man's will was clear and unambiguous, such evidence cannot be used to support the child's claim to the residence.

(Choice D) Had the man's will included a condition of survivorship instructing that the residence go to the child in the event that the friend predeceased the man, the child would have received the residence. But since the man's will included no such condition, the residence should be distributed to the charity.

Educational objective: The doctrine of lapse causes a devise to fail when the beneficiary predeceases the testator. The devised property will instead be distributed in accordance with other devises in the will or, if no others exist, in accordance with intestacy laws.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 55%（正确选项），C选项 29%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

影响遗嘱转让的法律原则


Lapse如果受益人先于立遗嘱人去世，则导致遗赠失败
Ademption通过以下任一方式导致遗赠失败：
  • 标的物灭失 - 特别遗赠的财产在立遗嘱人去世时已不为其所有（或被毁坏或发生根本性改变）
  • 清偿满足 - 受益人在立遗嘱人生前已收到遗赠的财产（或旨在满足该遗赠的其他资产）
Exoneration允许特别遗赠的不动产的受益人使用遗产的剩余资产来清偿该财产上的任何负担
Abatement在清偿立遗嘱人的债务后，当剩余资产不足以满足所有遗赠时，按比例削减遗赠。剩余财产遗赠首先被削减，其次是一般遗赠，最后是特别遗赠。
该男子（立遗嘱人）立有遗嘱去世，并根据一份有效遗嘱将其住宅遗赠给其朋友（受益人）。然而，遗赠落空原则 (doctrine of lapse) 规定，如果受益人先于立遗嘱人死亡（如此案所示），则遗赠将失败。在这种情况下，受益人或其继承人均无法获得该遗赠财产。相反，该财产将成为普通遗产的一部分，并根据遗嘱的其余规定进行分配。如果遗嘱中没有其他规定，该财产将根据无遗嘱继承法进行分配。但由于该男子将其遗产的剩余部分留给了慈善机构，因此遗产应将该住宅分配给慈善机构，而非孩子。

(选项A) 如果立遗嘱人在去世时不拥有已遗赠的财产，遗赠撤销原则 (doctrine of ademption) 会导致特定遗赠失败。但由于该男子去世时拥有该住宅，因此对朋友的遗赠并未因撤销而失效 (adeem)。

(选项C) 尽管有外部证据表明该男子的意图是使孩子受益，但口头证据规则禁止法院在遗嘱没有重大歧义的情况下重写遗嘱。由于该男子的遗嘱清晰无歧义，因此该证据不能用于支持孩子对住宅的主张。

(选项D) 如果该男子的遗嘱中包含存活条件，指示若朋友先于该男子死亡，则住宅归孩子所有，那么孩子本应获得该住宅。但由于该男子的遗嘱中没有此类条件，因此住宅应分配给慈善机构。

教学目标：当受益人先于立遗嘱人死亡时，遗赠落空原则 (doctrine of lapse) 会导致遗赠失败。该遗赠财产将转而根据遗嘱中的其他遗赠进行分配，或者在没有其他遗赠的情况下，根据无遗嘱继承法进行分配。

References

80 Am. Jur. 2d Wills § 1409 (2018) (doctrine of lapse).

MBE 考点解析

遗赠落空与剩余财产分配

核心考点：遗赠落空原则 (Doctrine of Lapse)

在普通法下，如果遗嘱受益人（Beneficiary）先于立遗嘱人（Testator）去世，该遗赠将失效（Lapse）。

失效的遗赠不会自动转给受益人的后代，而是落入剩余财产 (Residuary Estate)。

本案关键事实分析
  • 遗嘱内容：住宅给朋友，剩余财产给慈善机构。
  • 发生事件：朋友先于立遗嘱人去世。
  • 关键限制：题目明确指出 "There is no applicable statute"（无适用的成文法/反落空法）。

由于没有“反落空法”(Anti-Lapse Statute) 来挽救这个遗赠，我们必须适用普通法的遗赠落空原则。

选项深度解析
选项 B 正确

慈善机构获得住宅，因为遗赠落空。

由于朋友先去世，且无成文法保护，给朋友的特定遗赠 (Specific Devise) 失效。失效的特定遗赠归入剩余财产 (Residuary Estate)。因为慈善机构是剩余财产受益人，所以住宅归慈善机构。

选项 A 错误

关键词：Ademption (遗赠撤销/灭失)

Ademption 发生在立遗嘱人去世时，遗赠的财产不再属于遗产的一部分（例如房子被卖了）。本案中，立遗嘱人去世时仍拥有该住宅，因此不适用 Ademption。

选项 C 错误

关键词：Extrinsic Evidence (外部证据)

虽然有证据表明立遗嘱人想照顾孩子，但遗嘱本身没有歧义 (Ambiguity)。根据口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule)，法院通常不会引入外部证据来改变遗嘱中明确的条款。遗嘱写的是给“朋友”，不是给“朋友的孩子”。

选项 D 错误

关键词：Survivorship (存活条件)

这恰恰弄反了逻辑。正因为遗嘱中没有规定“如果朋友去世，则给孩子”这样的替代条款，且没有法律干预，遗赠才会落空并归入剩余财产。

🎓 MBE 抢分技巧：

1. 寻找 "Statute" 线索： 看到受益人先死，第一反应是找 Anti-Lapse Statute。如果题目说 "No applicable statute"，必须按普通法判 Lapse（遗赠失效）。

2. 区分概念：
  • Lapse: 人死了（受益人先死）。
  • Ademption: 物没了（财产不在遗产中）。
3. 尊重遗嘱字面含义： 除非遗嘱有歧义，否则不要用“立遗嘱人的心愿”（外部证据）去对抗明确的法律规则。

A man owned land in fee simple of record on January 10. On that day, a friend loaned the man $50,000 and the man mortgaged the land to her as security for the loan. The mortgage was recorded on January 18.
The man conveyed the land to a buyer for valuable consideration on January 11. The friend did not know of this, nor did the buyer know of the mortgage to the friend, until both discovered the facts on January 23, the day on which the buyer recorded the man's deed.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." There is no provision for a period of grace and there is no other relevant statutory provision.
The friend sued the buyer to establish that her mortgage was good against the land.
For whom should the court decide?

choices.a: The buyer, because he paid valuable consideration without notice before the friend recorded her mortgage.
choices.b: The buyer, because the friend's delay in recording means that she is estopped from asserting her priority in time.
choices.c: The friend, because after the mortgage to her, the man's deed to the buyer was necessarily subject to her mortgage.
choices.d: The friend, because the buyer did not record his deed before her mortgage was recorded.

data.questionStem:
Q86214

A man owned land in fee simple of record on January 10. On that day, a friend loaned the man $50,000 and the man mortgaged the land to her as security for the loan. The mortgage was recorded on January 18.

The man conveyed the land to a buyer for valuable consideration on January 11. The friend did not know of this, nor did the buyer know of the mortgage to the friend, until both discovered the facts on January 23, the day on which the buyer recorded the man's deed.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." There is no provision for a period of grace and there is no other relevant statutory provision.

The friend sued the buyer to establish that her mortgage was good against the land.

For whom should the court decide?

一名男子于1月10日拥有有记录的 fee simple（完全所有权）土地。当日，一位朋友借给该男子50,000美元，该男子将土地抵押给她作为贷款担保。该抵押于1月18日登记。

该男子于1月11日将土地以有值对价转让给一位买方。朋友对此不知情，买方也不知道该土地已抵押给朋友，直到1月23日，即买方登记该男子地契的当天，双方才发现事实。

该司法管辖区的登记法规定：“任何未经登记的不动产转让或抵押，对于率先登记的、支付对价且不知情的后续购买者，均不具有对抗效力。” 法律没有宽限期的规定，也没有其他相关的法定条款。

朋友起诉买方，要求确认其抵押权对该土地有效。

法院应为谁做出判决？
options:
A. The buyer, because he paid valuable consideration without notice before the friend recorded her mortgage.
买方，因为他在朋友登记其抵押权之前，支付了有值对价并且对此不知情。

B. The buyer, because the friend's delay in recording means that she is estopped from asserting her priority in time.
买方，因为朋友延迟登记意味着她被禁止反言（estoppel），不能主张其在时间上的优先权。

C. The friend, because after the mortgage to her, the man's deed to the buyer was necessarily subject to her mortgage.
朋友，因为在她获得抵押权后，该男子转让给买方的地契必然受其抵押权的约束。

D. The friend, because the buyer did not record his deed before her mortgage was recorded.
朋友，因为买方未能在她的抵押权登记之前登记其地契。
data.explanation:
Recording acts seek to promote certainty of title by creating a framework to determine the priority of competing property interests. In a race-notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest will have priority over an earlier property interest if the BFP:
  • lacked notice of the earlier interest at the time the BFP acquired his/her interest and
  • recorded his/her interest at any time before the earlier interest was recorded.

Here, the buyer was unaware of the friend's prior mortgage when he purchased the land. But since he did not record his deed until after the friend had recorded her mortgage, the court should decide for the friend.

(Choice A) Although the buyer paid valuable consideration without notice before the friend recorded her mortgage (ie, he was a BFP who lacked notice), he did not also record his deed before the friend recorded her mortgage.

(Choice B) The friend's delay in recording does not estop (ie, preclude) her from asserting her priority in time since there is no deadline for recording. She only needed to record her mortgage first (ie, before the buyer recorded his deed) to prevail in this race-notice jurisdiction. And since she did so, the court should find for the friend.

(Choice C) The man's deed to the buyer was not necessarily subject to the friend's mortgage. Instead, the friend will prevail because this jurisdiction has a race-notice statute and her mortgage was recorded first.

Educational objective: In a race-notice jurisdiction, a bona fide purchaser's (BFP's) property interest has priority over an earlier competing property interest if the BFP:
  • lacked notice of the earlier interest and
  • recorded first.




选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 2%，C选项 6%，D选项 69%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

登记法 (Recording acts) 旨在通过建立一个框架来确定相互冲突的产权的优先顺序，从而提高产权的确定性。在一个竞赛-通知型司法管辖区 (race-notice jurisdiction)（如本案所示），一个善意购买者 (bona fide purchaser, BFP) 的产权将优先于一个更早的产权，如果该善意购买者：
  • 在取得其产权时对先前的权利不知情，并且
  • 在先前的权利被登记之前，登记了自己的权利。

在本案中，买方在购买土地时并不知道朋友的先前抵押权。但由于他直到朋友登记了她的抵押权之后才登记他的地契，法院应判决朋友胜诉。

(选项A) 尽管买方在朋友登记其抵押权之前支付了有值对价并且不知情（即，他是一个不知情的善意购买者），但他没有在朋友登记其抵押权之前登记他的地契。

(选项B) 朋友的延迟登记并不构成禁止反言（即，阻止）她主张时间上的优先权，因为登记没有最后期限。她只需要在这个竞赛-通知型司法管辖区首先登记她的抵押权（即，在买方登记他的地契之前）就能胜诉。既然她这样做了，法院就应该判决朋友胜诉。

(选项C) 该男子转让给买方的地契并不必然受朋友抵押权的约束。相反，朋友会胜诉是因为该司法管辖区有竞赛-通知型法规，并且她的抵押权被首先登记。

教学目标：在一个竞赛-通知型司法管辖区，一个善意购买者（BFP）的产权优先于一个更早的、有冲突的产权，如果该善意购买者：
  • 对先前的权利不知情，并且
  • 率先登记。

MBE 考点解析：不动产登记法

本题的核心考点在于识别并应用竞赛-通知型法规 (Race-Notice Statute)。

在不动产法中，当同一块土地出现多个相互冲突的权益时（本案中为“朋友的抵押权”与“买方的所有权”），谁拥有优先权取决于该司法管辖区的登记法规。

1. 识别法规类型

题目中的关键法条是：

"No unrecorded conveyance... shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."

这句话包含了两个要素：

  • Without notice（不知情）：要求后续购买者是善意的。
  • Who shall first record（率先登记）：要求后续购买者必须赢得“登记竞赛”。

因此，这是一个 Race-Notice Jurisdiction（竞赛-通知型管辖区）。

2. 关键时间线分析

1月10日
朋友获得抵押权（未登记）。
1月11日
买方购买土地（支付对价，不知情）。
*此时买方是善意购买者 (BFP)。
1月18日
朋友登记抵押权。
1月23日
买方登记地契。

3. 法律适用与结论

在 Race-Notice 规则下，后续购买者（买方）要战胜先前的权益持有者（朋友），必须同时满足两个条件：

  1. 善意 (Bona Fide)： 购买时不知情且支付了对价。 ✔ (满足)
  2. 率先登记 (Record First)： 在先前权益登记之前完成登记。 ✘ (未满足)

结论： 虽然买方是善意购买者 (BFP)，但他输掉了“登记竞赛”（1月23日晚于1月18日）。因此，朋友的抵押权优先。

正确答案 D：朋友胜诉，因为买方未能在朋友登记之前登记其地契。

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 A (错在忽略了"Race")
    这是典型的陷阱。如果该州是 Notice Jurisdiction（通知型管辖区），买方只需在购买时“不知情”即可胜诉，无需率先登记。但本题明确规定了 "who shall first record"，所以仅有不知情是不够的。
  • 选项 B (错在 Estoppel)
    单纯的延迟登记（1月10日到18日）并不构成禁止反言 (Estoppel)。法律没有规定必须在多少天内登记，只要在竞争对手登记前登记即可。
  • 选项 C (错在逻辑)
    这描述的是普通法下的“时间优先”原则。但在有登记法的情况下，登记法会改变优先顺序。朋友胜诉不是因为地契“必然”受限，而是因为她赢得了登记竞赛。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到登记法题目，请按以下步骤操作：

  1. 找关键词：
    • 仅有 "without notice" = Notice Statute
    • 仅有 "first record" = Race Statute
    • 同时有 "without notice" 和 "first record" = Race-Notice Statute
  2. 画时间轴： 标出权益产生时间和登记时间。
  3. 定胜负： 根据法规类型判断谁优先。

questions.question:
An environmentalist conveyed his land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his daughter, who did not then record her deed. Later, the environmentalist conveyed the land by warranty deed to a buyer, who paid valuable consideration, knew nothing of the daughter's claim, and promptly and properly recorded. Next, the daughter recorded her deed. Then the buyer conveyed the land by quitclaim deed to his son as a gift. When the possible conflict with the daughter was discovered, the son recorded his deed.
The land at all relevant times has been vacant unoccupied land.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." No other statute is applicable.
The son has sued the daughter to establish who owns the land.
For whom will the court hold?

choices.a: The daughter, because she recorded before the son.
choices.b: The daughter, because the son was a subsequent donee.
choices.c: The son, because the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights.
choices.d: The son, because the daughter was a donee.

data.questionStem:
Q86233

An environmentalist conveyed his land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his daughter, who did not then record her deed. Later, the environmentalist conveyed the land by warranty deed to a buyer, who paid valuable consideration, knew nothing of the daughter's claim, and promptly and properly recorded. Next, the daughter recorded her deed. Then the buyer conveyed the land by quitclaim deed to his son as a gift. When the possible conflict with the daughter was discovered, the son recorded his deed.

The land at all relevant times has been vacant unoccupied land.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record." No other statute is applicable.

The son has sued the daughter to establish who owns the land.

Who will the court will hold for?

一位环保主义者通过一份无担保契据（quitclaim deed）将他的土地作为礼物赠与了他的女儿，女儿当时并未登记其契据。之后，该环保主义者通过一份担保契据（warranty deed）将该土地转让给了一位买家，该买家支付了有价对价，对女儿的权利主张一无所知，并及时且恰当地进行了登记。随后，女儿登记了她的契据。然后，买家通过一份无担保契据（quitclaim deed）将该土地作为礼物赠与了他的儿子。当发现与女儿可能存在权利冲突时，儿子登记了他的契据。

在所有相关时间内，该土地一直是空置未被占用的土地。

该司法管辖区的登记法案规定：“任何未经登记的不动产转让或抵押，对于在先登记的、支付了价金且无通知的后续购买者无效。” 无其他适用法规。

儿子已起诉女儿，以确定谁拥有该土地。

法院将支持哪一方？
options:
A. The daughter, because she recorded before the son.
女儿，因为她在儿子之前进行了登记。

B. The daughter, because the son was a subsequent donee.
女儿，因为儿子是后续的受赠人。

C. The son, because the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights.
儿子，因为买家的购买行为切断了女儿的权利。

D. The son, because the daughter was a donee.
儿子，因为女儿是受赠人。
data.explanation:
The priority of competing property interests is determined by the jurisdiction's recording act. In a race-notice jurisdiction (as seen here), a purchaser has priority over another's earlier property interest if the purchaser:
  • is bona fide (ie, a BFP) because the purchaser obtained an interest in property without notice of the earlier interest and recorded first.


Under the Shelter Rule, a person who receives a property interest from a BFP is entitled to the same protection under the recording act as the BFP - even if that person would not otherwise be protected by the recording act.

Here, the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights because the buyer knew nothing of the daughter's prior interest (BFP) and recorded his deed before the daughter recorded hers.† And though the son received the land as a gift from the buyer (not a BFP) and recorded his deed after the daughter recorded hers, the Shelter Rule entitles him to the buyer's protection under this jurisdiction's race-notice act. As a result, the court should rule for the son.

†Had the buyer recorded his deed after the daughter recorded hers, the buyer would not have had priority under the recording act and the daughter would have prevailed.

(Choices A & B) The recording act would not ordinarily protect the son from the daughter's prior claim since he was a donee (not a BFP) and the daughter recorded before him. But since he was gifted the land by a BFP (the buyer) who recorded before the daughter, the son is protected from her claim under the Shelter Rule.

(Choice D) The daughter's status as a donee would only matter if she were seeking to establish priority over an earlier competing interest in the land. Since she has the earlier claim here, her status as a donee is irrelevant.

Educational objective: In a race-notice jurisdiction, a purchaser who lacks notice of an earlier property interest (BFP) and records first will prevail. And under the Shelter Rule, a person who receives a property interest from a BFP is entitled to the same protection under the recording act as the BFP.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 2%，C选项 74%（正确选项），D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

相互冲突的财产权的优先顺序由该司法管辖区的登记法案决定。在一个race-notice jurisdiction（如本案所示）中，如果一名购买者满足以下条件，其相对于他人的在先财产权享有优先权：
  • 是善意的（即，善意购买者 BFP），因为该购买者在获得财产权益时对在先权益不知情并且率先进行了登记。


根据 Shelter Rule，从善意购买者（BFP）处获得财产权益的人，有权享有与该善意购买者（BFP）根据登记法案所享有的同等保护——即使该人本身在其他情况下可能不受登记法案的保护。

在本案中，买家的购买行为切断了女儿的权利，因为买家对女儿的在先权益一无所知（属于善意购买者 BFP），并且在女儿登记她的契据之前登记了自己的契据。† 并且，尽管儿子是从买家那里以礼物形式获得该土地（自身并非善意购买者 BFP），并且在女儿登记她的契据之后才登记自己的契据，但 Shelter Rule 使他有权享有买家在该司法管辖区的 race-notice 法案下的保护。因此，法院应裁定儿子胜诉。

†如果买家在女儿登记之后才登记其契据，那么根据登记法案，买家将不享有优先权，而女儿将会胜诉。

(选项 A & B) 登记法案通常不会保护儿子免受女儿的在先权利主张的影响，因为儿子是受赠人（并非善意购买者 BFP），且女儿在他之前进行了登记。但是，由于他是从一位在女儿之前登记的善意购买者（BFP）（即买家）那里获赠土地，因此根据 Shelter Rule，儿子确实受到保护，可以对抗女儿的权利主张。

(选项 D) 女儿作为受赠人的身份，仅当她试图确立其相对于土地上更早的冲突权益的优先权时才具有意义。由于在本案中她拥有的是在先的权利主张，因此她作为受赠人的身份是无关紧要的。

教学目标：在一个 race-notice jurisdiction 中，对在先财产权益不知情（属于善意购买者 BFP）并率先登记的购买者将胜诉。并且，根据 Shelter Rule，从善意购买者（BFP）处获得财产权益的人，有权享有与该善意购买者（BFP）根据登记法案所享有的同等保护。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Recording Acts
核心考点：庇护规则 (Shelter Rule)

即使受让人（Transferee）本身不满足善意购买人（BFP）的条件（例如他是受赠人或知情人），只要他是从一个受登记法案保护的 BFP 处获得产权，他就“继承”了该 BFP 的保护地位。

案件逻辑推演

本案适用的法规 (Race-Notice Act)：
后续购买者若要胜出，必须满足两点：
1. 支付对价且无通知 (BFP)；
2. 率先登记 (First Record)。
1. 父亲赠与女儿 Gift
女儿未登记。此时女儿拥有产权，但面临风险。
2. 父亲卖给买家 BFP 先登记
买家支付了对价，不知情，且先于女儿登记。
➡ 买家切断了女儿的权利 (Cut off rights)。
3. 女儿补登记
太晚了，买家已经根据法案胜出。
4. 买家赠与儿子 Gift
虽然儿子是受赠人（Donee），但他受到庇护规则 (Shelter Rule) 的保护。
正确答案：C

"The son, because the buyer's purchase cut off the daughter's rights."

深度解析：
本题的关键在于理解权利链条。

1. 买家 vs. 女儿： 买家是善意购买人（BFP）且率先登记。根据 Race-Notice 法案，买家拥有优于女儿的产权。此时，女儿的产权实际上已被“消灭”。

2. 儿子 vs. 女儿： 儿子虽然是受赠人（Donee），通常不受登记法案保护（因为没有支付对价）。但是，Shelter Rule 允许儿子“躲在”买家的保护伞下。既然买家已经拥有了对抗女儿的完美产权，买家就有权将这个完美的产权转让给任何人（包括受赠人）。

为什么其他选项是错的？
  • A (女儿先于儿子登记): 错误。关键比较是“买家 vs 女儿”。买家赢了，儿子继承买家的地位。儿子何时登记已不重要。
  • B & D (儿子是受赠人): 错误。虽然受赠人通常不被保护，但 Shelter Rule 是例外。如果不能将产权传给受赠人，买家的产权价值就会打折，这违背了保护 BFP 的初衷。

questions.question:
A man conveyed land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his cousin, who did not then record the deed or take possession of the land. Six months later, when the man was still in possession, he conveyed the land by quitclaim deed as a gift to a friend, who knew nothing of the deed to the cousin. The friend did not record his deed. The man then vacated the land, and the friend took possession.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides as follows: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."
Recently, the cousin learned about the friend's deed and possession, immediately recorded her deed, and sued the friend for possession and to quiet title. The friend then recorded his deed and raised all available defenses.
For whom is the court likely to decide?

choices.a: For the cousin, because she was first in time and the friend was not a purchaser.
choices.b: For the cousin, because the friend failed to first record.
choices.c: For the friend, because a subsequent good-faith donee has priority over a prior donee who fails to record.
choices.d: For the friend, because he was first in possession.

data.questionStem:
Q86818 A man conveyed land by quitclaim deed as a gift to his cousin, who did not then record the deed or take possession of the land. Six months later, when the man was still in possession, he conveyed the land by quitclaim deed as a gift to a friend, who knew nothing of the deed to the cousin. The friend did not record his deed. The man then vacated the land, and the friend took possession.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides as follows: "No unrecorded conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value without notice, who shall first record."

Recently, the cousin learned about the friend's deed and possession, immediately recorded her deed, and sued the friend for possession and to quiet title. The friend then recorded his deed and raised all available defenses.

For whom is the court likely to decide? 一名男子通过产权放弃契据将土地作为礼物转让给他的堂/表妹，后者当时并未登记该契据也未占有该土地。六个月后，在该男子仍占有该土地时，他通过产权放弃契据将土地作为礼物转让给一位朋友，该朋友对转让给堂/表妹的契据一无所知。该朋友没有登记他的契据。然后，该男子搬离了该土地，朋友开始占有。

该司法管辖区的登记法规定如下：“未登记的房地产转让或抵押，对于优先登记的后续无通知的有偿购买者无效。”

最近，堂/表妹得知了朋友的契据和占有情况，立即登记了她的契据，并起诉该朋友，要求获得占有权并进行产权确认诉讼。朋友随后也登记了他的契据，并提出了所有可用的抗辩。

法院可能会做出对谁有利的判决？
options:
A. For the cousin, because she was first in time and the friend was not a purchaser.
为堂/表妹，因为她在时间上优先，而且朋友不是购买者。

B. For the cousin, because the friend failed to first record.
为堂/表妹，因为朋友未能优先登记。

C. For the friend, because a subsequent good-faith donee has priority over a prior donee who fails to record.
为朋友，因为后续的善意受赠人相对于未登记的在先受赠人享有优先权。

D. For the friend, because he was first in possession.
为朋友，因为他首先占有。
data.explanation:
Priority of subsequent property interests


Recording actRaceInterest holder who records first will prevail
NoticeSubsequent bona fide purchaser (BFP) without notice of earlier interest will prevail
Race-noticeSubsequent BFP who lacks notice of earlier interest & records first will prevail
Common lawFirst in timeEarlier interest holder will prevail over subsequent interest holders
A jurisdiction's recording act is typically used to determine priority among competing interests in the same property. But if the recording act does not apply, priority will be determined under the common law "first-in-time" rule, which gives earlier property interests priority over subsequent property interests.

This jurisdiction's recording act (a race-notice statute) only protects subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of a competing claim and record first. Since the man gifted his land to the cousin and then to the friend (ie, they were not purchasers), the recording act does not apply. Instead, the dispute will be resolved under the "first-in-time" rule. And the court will likely find for the cousin because she received her property interest before the friend received his.

(Choice B) Had the friend been a purchaser for value, he would have needed to record his property interest first to protect it under the jurisdiction's race-notice act. But since the friend was a gift recipient, the recording act does not apply and the friend will not lose on this basis.

(Choice C) An earlier donee's property interest always has priority over a subsequent donee's interest in a race-notice jurisdiction. The fact that the subsequent donee was a good-faith donee (ie, had no notice of the prior donee's interest) is immaterial.

(Choice D) The common law "first-in-time" rule gives priority to whoever acquires the property interest first—not whoever takes possession first. So, the cousin (not the friend) will prevail because she was gifted the land first.

Educational objective: Priority among competing interests in the same property is generally evaluated under the jurisdiction's recording act. But if the recording act does not apply, priority will be assessed under the common law "first-in-time" rule, which prioritizes earlier property interests over subsequent ones.

后续财产权益的优先权


登记法竞赛型优先登记者将获胜
通知型对早期权益不知情的后续善意有偿购买者（BFP）将获胜
竞赛-通知型对早期权益不知情且优先登记的后续善意有偿购买者将获胜
普通法时间优先早期权益持有人将优先于后续权益持有人
一个司法管辖区的登记法通常用于确定同一财产上相互冲突的权益的优先顺序。但如果登记法不适用，优先权将根据普通法“时间优先”规则来确定，该规则赋予较早的财产权益优先于后续的财产权益。

该司法管辖区的登记法（一个竞赛-通知型法规）仅保护那些对竞争性权利主张不知情且优先登记的后续有偿购买者。由于该男子将土地赠与其堂/表妹，然后又赠与朋友（即他们不是购买者），因此登记法不适用。相反，争议将根据“时间优先”规则解决。法院可能会判决堂/表妹胜诉，因为她先于朋友获得了她的财产权益。

(选项 B) 如果朋友是有偿购买者，他本需要优先登记其财产权益，以根据该司法管辖区的竞赛-通知型法案保护其权益。但由于朋友是礼物接受者（受赠人），登记法不适用，朋友不会因此败诉。

(选项 C) 在竞赛-通知型司法管辖区，在先受赠人的财产权益总是优先于后续受赠人的权益。后续受赠人是善意受赠人（即对在先受赠人的权益不知情）这一事实无关紧要。

(选项 D) 普通法的“时间优先”规则将优先权赋予首先获得财产权益的人——而不是首先占有财产的人。因此，堂/表妹（而不是朋友）将获胜，因为她首先被赠与了这片土地。

教学目标： 同一财产上相互冲突的权益之间的优先权，通常根据该司法管辖区的登记法进行评估。但如果登记法不适用，则优先权将根据普通法的“时间优先”规则进行评判，该规则使较早的财产权益优先于后续的财产权益。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts & Donees

🔑 核心原则 (The Golden Rule) 在财产法中，登记法 (Recording Acts) 仅保护“有偿购买者” (Purchasers for Value)。如果后续受让人是受赠人 (Donee)，登记法不适用，必须回归普通法 (Common Law) 规则。
1 识别当事人身份

本案中有两个受让人：

  • 堂妹 (Cousin): 接受礼物 (Gift) → 受赠人 (Donee)。
  • 朋友 (Friend): 接受礼物 (Gift) → 受赠人 (Donee)。

注意：两人都没有支付对价 (Value)，都不是购买者 (Purchaser)。

2 分析登记法是否适用

题目中的法规规定：“未登记的转让...对于有偿购买者 (Purchasers for Value) 无效...”

由于后续受让人（朋友）是受赠人而非购买者，他不受该登记法的保护。无论他是否知道之前的转让，也无论他是否先登记，他都无法利用该法规来切断堂妹的权益。

3 应用普通法规则

当登记法不适用时，适用普通法的“时间优先” (First in Time, First in Right) 规则。

堂妹在六个月前获得了产权（尽管未登记），她在时间上早于朋友。因此，堂妹拥有该土地的产权。

✅ 正确答案：选项 A

判决应有利于堂妹。因为她是时间上的第一顺位 (First in time)，而朋友不是“购买者” (Purchaser)，无法援引登记法来推翻普通法的优先权规则。
❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 B (朋友未先登记): 推理错误。即使朋友先登记了，结果也一样。因为他不是购买者，登记法的“先登记”要求对他不产生保护作用。
选项 C (善意受赠人): 法律误区。登记法保护的是“善意购买者” (BFP)，从不保护“善意受赠人”。受赠人只能站在捐赠人 (Grantor) 的鞋子里，如果捐赠人已经把地送人了，受赠人就什么也得不到。
选项 D (先占有): 无关因素。在产权归属纠纷中，除非涉及逆权占有 (Adverse Possession)，否则单纯的“占有”并不决定产权归属。产权由有效的契据交付 (Delivery of Deed) 决定。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 看到 Recording Act 题目时，第一步永远是检查后续受让人 (Subsequent Grantee) 是否支付了对价 (Value)。

如果是 Gift、Will (遗嘱) 或 Heir (继承)，他们通常不受登记法保护（除非 Shelter Rule 适用）。此时直接选时间最早的那个人。

questions.question:
An uncle was the record title holder of a vacant tract of land. He often told friends that he would leave the land to his nephew in his will. The nephew knew of these conversations. Prior to the uncle's death, the nephew conveyed the land by warranty deed to a woman for $100,000. She did not conduct a title search of the land before she accepted the deed from the nephew. She promptly and properly recorded her deed. Last month, the uncle died, leaving the land to the nephew in his duly probated will. Both the nephew and the woman now claim ownership of the land. The nephew has offered to return the $100,000 to the woman.
Who has title to the land?

choices.a: The nephew, because at the time of the deed to the woman, the uncle was the owner of record.
choices.b: The nephew, because the woman did not conduct a title search.
choices.c: The woman, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
choices.d: The woman, because she recorded her deed prior to the uncle's death.

data.questionStem:
Q86217

An uncle was the record title holder of a vacant tract of land. He often told friends that he would leave the land to his nephew in his will. The nephew knew of these conversations. Prior to the uncle's death, the nephew conveyed the land by warranty deed to a woman for $100,000. She did not conduct a title search of the land before she accepted the deed from the nephew. She promptly and properly recorded her deed. Last month, the uncle died, leaving the land to the nephew in his duly probated will. Both the nephew and the woman now claim ownership of the land. The nephew has offered to return the $100,000 to the woman.

Who has title to the land?

一位叔叔是一块空地的有记录的产权所有人。他经常告诉朋友，他将在遗嘱中将这块土地留给他的侄子。侄子知道这些谈话。在叔叔去世前，侄子通过一份担保契约以10万美元的价格将土地转让给了一名女子。在接受侄子的契约之前，她没有对土地进行产权调查。她及时并妥善地登记了她的契约。上个月，叔叔去世了，在他经过正式遗嘱认证的遗嘱中将土地留给了侄子。现在，侄子和该女子都声称拥有这块土地的所有权。侄子提出将10万美元退还给该女子。

谁拥有这块土地的产权？
options:
A. The nephew, because at the time of the deed to the woman, the uncle was the owner of record.
侄子，因为在向该女子转让契约时，叔叔是有记录的所有人。

B. The nephew, because the woman did not conduct a title search.
侄子，因为该女子没有进行产权调查。

C. The woman, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
该女子，因为契约不容反悔原则 (doctrine of estoppel by deed)。

D. The woman, because she recorded her deed prior to the uncle's death.
该女子，因为她在叔叔去世前登记了她的契约。
data.explanation:
In general, a grantor can only convey title to property that he/she owns. But when unowned property is conveyed by warranty deed, that conveyance will become effective if the grantor later acquires title due to the doctrine of estoppel by deed (ie, after-acquired title). This doctrine causes the grantor's after-acquired title to automatically transfer to the grantee. The grantee can then choose to accept that transfer or reject it (and sue for damages).

Here, the nephew conveyed the land to the woman for $100,000 by warranty deed. Since the uncle (not the nephew) owned the land at that time, the conveyance was ineffective. But it became effective - and title automatically transferred to the woman - when the nephew later acquired title under the uncle's will (Choice A). And since the woman accepted that transfer by claiming ownership, she has title to the land.

(Choice B) A grantee has no obligation to conduct a title search before accepting a deed or claiming ownership of property. Therefore, the woman's failure to search the land records is immaterial.

(Choice D) Recording protects property owners from subsequent ownership claims. Here, the woman recorded the deed before the uncle's death and before the nephew acquired title to the land under the uncle's will. But since she acquired title after the nephew, the recording would not protect her from his earlier ownership claim.

Educational objective:

The doctrine of estoppel by deed (ie, after-acquired title) effectuates a conveyance of unowned property by warranty deed when the grantor later acquires ownership of that property. The grantor's ownership interest automatically transfers to the grantee, who can then accept or reject the transfer.



选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 2%，C选项 83%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

通常，转让人只能转让他/她所拥有的财产的产权。但是，当转让人通过担保契约转让其不拥有的财产时，如果转让人后来因契约不容反悔原则 (doctrine of estoppel by deed)（即，事后获得的产权 (after-acquired title)）而获得产权，则该转让将生效。该原则使得转让人的事后获得的产权 (after-acquired title)自动转移给受让人。受让人随后可以选择接受该转让或拒绝该转让（并起诉要求赔偿损失）。

在本案中，侄子通过担保契约以10万美元的价格将土地转让给了该女子。由于当时拥有该土地的是叔叔（而不是侄子），因此该转让是无效的。但是，当侄子后来根据叔叔的遗嘱获得产权时，该转让即生效——并且产权自动转移给了该女子（选项 A）。并且，由于该女子通过主张所有权接受了该转让，她便拥有了这块土地的产权。

（选项 B）在接受契约或主张财产所有权之前，受让人没有义务进行产权调查。因此，该女子未能调查土地记录是无关紧要的。

（选项 D）登记可以保护产权所有人免受后续所有权主张的侵害。在本案中，该女子在叔叔去世前、在侄子根据叔叔遗嘱获得土地产权前登记了契约。但是，由于她是在侄子获得产权后才获得产权的，登记行为无法保护她免受侄子先前所有权主张的影响。

教学目标：

契约不容反悔原则 (doctrine of estoppel by deed)（即，事后获得的产权 (after-acquired title)）使得在转让人通过担保契约转让其不拥有的财产，但之后又获得了该财产的所有权时，该转让生效。转让人的所有权权益自动转移给受让人，受让人可以选择接受或拒绝该转让。

References

23 Am. Jur. 2d Deeds § 278 (2018) (estoppel by deed).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Titles & Conveyance
✅ 正确答案：选项 C
核心考点：契约不容反悔原则
Estoppel by Deed（也称为 After-Acquired Title Doctrine）。

当一个人在没有所有权的情况下，通过担保契约 (Warranty Deed) 试图转让房产，如果他后来获得了该房产的所有权，那么该所有权会自动转移给受让人 (Grantee)。
📊 案件逻辑推演
1
转让时 (Conveyance)：
侄子将土地卖给女子。此时土地属于叔叔。侄子无权处分，但签署了 Warranty Deed。
2
继承时 (Inheritance)：
叔叔去世，侄子通过遗嘱获得土地所有权 (After-Acquired Title)。
3
法律后果 (Result)：
根据 Estoppel by Deed，产权瞬间、自动穿过侄子，转移给女子。侄子被禁止 (Estopped) 否认之前的转让有效性。
💡 深度解析

本题考察的是普通法中的一个公平原则。侄子既然已经收了钱并承诺（通过 Warranty Deed）转让土地，法律就不允许他在真正获得土地后反悔。

虽然在转让发生时，契约在技术上是无效的（因为侄子没有产权），但一旦侄子获得了产权，该产权就会“补正”之前的契约瑕疵。

注意：受让人（女子）有权选择接受这个迟来的产权，或者拒绝并起诉违约。但在本题中，女子主张所有权，说明她选择了接受。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误
虽然转让时叔叔是所有人，但这并不意味着侄子现在可以保留土地。正是因为侄子后来获得了土地，才触发了 Estoppel by Deed 原则。
选项 B 错误
Title Search (产权调查) 是为了保护买家免受第三方权利主张的影响。未进行产权调查可能导致她对第三方处于劣势，但在她和卖家（侄子）之间，卖家不能利用买家的疏忽来逃避自己的担保责任。
选项 D 错误
Recording (登记) 主要解决的是“多重买卖”中的优先权问题。虽然她登记了，但她胜诉的根本原因不是因为她登记早，而是因为 Estoppel by Deed 原则将产权转移给了她。如果侄子把地卖给了另一个不知情的善意第三人 (BFP)，登记才会成为关键因素。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧
看到以下组合时，立即联想 Estoppel by Deed：
  1. 卖家目前没有产权 (No title yet)。
  2. 卖家签署了担保契约 (Warranty Deed)。
  3. 卖家后来获得了产权 (Later acquires title)。

结论：产权自动归买家所有。

questions.question:
A landowner executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey his land to a friend. The landowner handed the instrument to the friend, saying, "This is yours, but please do not record it until after I am dead. Otherwise, it will cause me no end of trouble with my relatives." Two days later, the landowner asked the friend to return the deed to him because he had decided that he should devise the land to the friend by will rather than by deed. The friend said that he would destroy the deed and a day or so later falsely told the landowner that the deed had been destroyed. Six months ago, the landowner, who had never executed a will, died intestate, survived by a daughter as his sole heir. The day after the landowner's death, the friend recorded the deed from him. As soon as the daughter discovered this recording and the friend's claim to the land, she brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the land.
For whom should the court hold?

choices.a: The daughter, because the death of the landowner deprived the subsequent recording of any effect.
choices.b: The daughter, because the friend was dishonest in reporting that he had destroyed the deed.
choices.c: The friend, because the deed was delivered to him.
choices.d: The friend, because the deed was recorded by him.

Q86238

A landowner executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey his land to a friend. The landowner handed the instrument to the friend, saying, "This is yours, but please do not record it until after I am dead. Otherwise, it will cause me no end of trouble with my relatives." Two days later, the landowner asked the friend to return the deed to him because he had decided that he should devise the land to the friend by will rather than by deed. The friend said that he would destroy the deed and a day or so later falsely told the landowner that the deed had been destroyed. Six months ago, the landowner, who had never executed a will, died intestate, survived by a daughter as his sole heir. The day after the landowner's death, the friend recorded the deed from him. As soon as the daughter discovered this recording and the friend's claim to the land, she brought an appropriate action against the friend to quiet title to the land.

For whom should the court hold?

一位土地所有者签署了一份格式正确的deed文书，意图将其土地转让给一位朋友。该土地所有者将该文书交给朋友，并说道：“这是你的了，但在我去世之前请不要登记它。否则，这会给我和我的亲戚们带来无尽的麻烦。”两天后，该土地所有者要求朋友将deed还给他，因为他决定应该通过遗嘱而不是deed将土地遗赠给朋友。该朋友说他会销毁该deed，并在一天左右后谎称该deed已被销毁。六个月前，该土地所有者在未立遗嘱的情况下无遗嘱死亡，其女儿是其唯一继承人。在该土地所有者去世后的第二天，该朋友登记了从他那里获得的deed。女儿一发现此次登记以及朋友对该土地的所有权主张，便对该朋友提起了适当的确认土地所有权诉讼。

法院应支持哪一方？
options:
A. The daughter, because the death of the landowner deprived the subsequent recording of any effect.
支持女儿，因为土地所有者的死亡使得随后的登记行为无效。

B. The daughter, because the friend was dishonest in reporting that he had destroyed the deed.
支持女儿，因为朋友谎报他已销毁deed的行为是不诚实的。

C. The friend, because the deed was delivered to him.
支持朋友，因为该deed已经交付给他。

D. The friend, because the deed was recorded by him.
支持朋友，因为该deed已由他登记。
data.explanation:
A deed is a document that transfers ownership of real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee) once it has been:

  • delivered - evidenced by the grantor's intent to presently convey ownership to the grantee and
  • accepted - presumed when the transfer benefits the grantee.


Delivery is presumed if the grantor hands the deed to the grantee. This presumption can generally be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not intend to presently transfer ownership. But evidence that the grantor gave the deed to the grantee subject to an oral condition is inadmissible , so that condition cannot be enforced.

Here, delivery is presumed since the landowner handed the deed to the friend. And that presumption is not rebuttable since evidence of the landowner's oral condition ("please do not record it until after I am dead") is inadmissible. Therefore, the condition is not enforceable, and the court should hold for the friend.

(Choices A & D) Recording a deed (ie, filing it in the official land records) after the grantor's death creates a presumption of delivery. But this presumption can be rebutted by evidence that the grantor did not deliver the deed during his/her life. Here, though the deed was not recorded until after the landowner's death, it was delivered during his life (when he handed it to the friend). Therefore, the land was effectively conveyed to the friend.

(Choice B) Once a deed has been delivered and accepted, the grantee owns the property and the transfer cannot be canceled (eg, by destroying the deed). Therefore, the friend's dishonesty in reporting that he had destroyed the deed is inconsequential.

Educational objective: A deed is delivered when the grantor intends to presently transfer ownership to the grantee (presumed when the deed is in the grantee's possession). Evidence that the grantor gave the deed to the grantee subject to an oral condition is inadmissible to rebut this presumption, and the condition is unenforceable.



选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 22%，C选项 62%（正确选项），D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

deed是一份文件，一旦它被：

  • 交付 - 以转让人意图立即转让所有权给受让人的意图为证并且
  • 接受 - 当转让对受让人有利时推定成立


它便将不动产的所有权从所有者（转让人）转移给另一方（受让人）。

如果转让人将deed交给受让人，则推定已经交付。这一推定通常可以通过证据被推翻，该证据需证明转让人无意立即转让所有权。但是，证明转让人将deed交给受让人时附带口头条件的证据是不可采纳的，因此该条件无法强制执行。

在本案中，由于土地所有者将deed交给了朋友，推定已经交付。并且该推定是不可推翻的，因为土地所有者口头条件（“在我去世之前请不要登记它”）的证据是不可采纳的。因此，该条件不可强制执行，法院应支持朋友。

(选项 A 和 D) 在转让人去世后登记deed（即在官方土地记录中存档）会产生交付的推定。但这一推定可以通过证据被推翻，该证据需证明转让人在其生前并未交付deed。在本案中，尽管deed直到土地所有者去世后才被登记，但它是在其生前交付的（当他把deed交给朋友时）。因此，土地已有效转让给朋友。

(选项 B) 一旦deed被交付并接受，受让人即拥有该财产，该转让不可被撤销（例如，通过销毁deed）。因此，朋友谎报他已销毁deed的不诚实行为是无关紧要的。

教学目标：当转让人意图立即将所有权转让给受让人时（当deed由受让人占有时，此意图被推定），deed即被视为交付。证明转让人在将deed交给受让人时附带口头条件的证据，是不可采纳用来推翻此推定的，且该条件不可强制执行。

MBE 考题解析

Real Property: Deeds & Delivery

✅ 正确答案
选项 C (The Friend)

法院应支持朋友，因为地契（Deed）已经完成了有效的交付 (Delivery)。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)

本题考察的是不动产法中关于地契交付 (Delivery of Deed) 的核心原则，特别是当交付附带口头条件 (Oral Condition) 时的处理方式。

规则一：交付即转让 (Delivery transfers title)
地契一旦有效交付并被受让人接受，所有权立即转移。此后，转让人不能单方面撤销（Revoke）或收回所有权。
规则二：对受让人的口头条件无效 (Oral condition to grantee is void)
如果转让人将地契直接交给受让人 (Grantee)，但口头附加了条件（例如：“在我死之前不要登记”或“如果我死在你前面这地才归你”），普通法（Common Law）的规则是：
  • 交付是有效的且绝对的 (Absolute)。
  • 口头条件是无效的 (Void/Unenforceable)。
这意味着所有权在交付的那一刻就已经无条件地转移了。
🔍 案情深度解析

让我们将规则应用到本案的具体事实中：

  1. 交付行为 (Act of Delivery)：
    土地所有者将地契亲手交给了朋友。这创造了强有力的交付推定。
  2. 转让意图 (Intent)：
    他说：“这是你的了 (This is yours)”。这表明了立即转让所有权的意图 (Present intent to convey)。
  3. 口头条件 (The Oral Condition)：
    他说：“但在我死之前请不要登记”。
    法律后果：根据上述规则，因为地契是直接交给受让人的，这个口头条件被视为无效。法律认为地契已绝对交付。朋友在拿到地契的那一刻，就已经成为了土地的合法所有者。
  4. 后续的反悔 (Change of Mind)：
    两天后所有者想要回地契改立遗嘱。
    法律后果：无效。因为所有权在两天前已经转移了。撕毁地契或归还纸质文件并不能把所有权转回去（必须重新签署一份新的地契由朋友转回给所有者）。
❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A 错误：
"Death deprived recording of effect"
虽然登记 (Recording) 通常在生前进行，但所有权的转移取决于交付 (Delivery)，而不是登记。只要在生前完成了交付，死后登记并不影响所有权的有效性。登记的主要目的是对抗第三方（如后续购买者），而不是确立所有权本身。

选项 B 错误：
"Dishonest in reporting"
虽然朋友撒谎说销毁了地契是不道德的，但这在财产法上无关紧要。一旦所有权转移（在第一次交付时），朋友是否有撒谎、是否归还了纸张，都不影响他已经拥有土地这一法律事实。

选项 D 错误：
"Because the deed was recorded"
这个选项的推理逻辑是错误的。朋友胜诉的原因是地契被交付 (Delivered)，而不是因为被登记。如果地契从未交付（例如是被偷走的），即使登记了也是无效的。登记只是证据，交付才是关键。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中遇到 Deed Delivery 问题时，请记住：

  • 物理转移 (Handing over) = 强烈的交付推定。
  • 给受让人的口头条件 (Oral condition to grantee) = 条件被忽略，交付视为绝对有效。
  • 给第三方的条件 (To 3rd party/Escrow) = 条件通常有效（这是与本题最大的区别）。
  • 后续反悔 = 无效。地契不是遗嘱，一旦交付不能随意撤回。

questions.question:
Two years ago, a developer conveyed title to a lot to a woman by warranty deed. The woman purchased an owner's policy of title insurance before the closing. Because of an error by the title insurance company, the title commitment and title policy failed to list a county tax lien encumbering the lot as an exception to coverage.
Last year, the woman conveyed the lot for a bargain price by quitclaim deed to a friend, who paid cash, did not conduct a title search, and did not purchase title insurance.
Subsequently, the county began proceedings to foreclose the tax lien, and the friend filed a claim with the woman's title insurance company, demanding that the company reimburse her for the tax lien amount.
Is the title insurance company obligated to pay the friend's claim?

choices.a: No, because the friend is not a named insured on the title insurance policy.
choices.b: No, because the title insurance policy expired when the woman conveyed the lot to the friend.
choices.c: Yes, because the tax lien was not listed as an exception on the title insurance policy.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman is liable to the friend for breach of the covenant against encumbrances, and the title policy should cover the friend's potential loss.

Q86830 Two years ago, a developer conveyed title to a lot to a woman by warranty deed. The woman purchased an owner's policy of title insurance before the closing. Because of an error by the title insurance company, the title commitment and title policy failed to list a county tax lien encumbering the lot as an exception to coverage.

Last year, the woman conveyed the lot for a bargain price by quitclaim deed to a friend, who paid cash, did not conduct a title search, and did not purchase title insurance.

Subsequently, the county began proceedings to foreclose the tax lien, and the friend filed a claim with the woman's title insurance company, demanding that the company reimburse her for the tax lien amount.

Is the title insurance company obligated to pay the friend's claim? 两年前，一名开发商通过担保契约将一块土地的所有权转让给了一名女士。该女士在交割前购买了一份业主产权保险单。由于产权保险公司的失误，产权承诺书和产权保单未能将对该土地构成负担的一项县级税务留置权列为承保范围的例外情况。

去年，该女士以优惠价格通过免责转让契约将该土地转让给了一位朋友，该朋友支付了现金，未进行产权调查，也未购买产权保险。

随后，县政府开始启动程序对该税务留置权进行强制执行，该朋友向该女士的产权保险公司提出索赔，要求该公司赔偿她税务留置权的金额。

产权保险公司是否有义务支付该朋友的索赔？
options:
A. No, because the friend is not a named insured on the title insurance policy.
否，因为该朋友不是产权保险单上的指定被保险人。

B. No, because the title insurance policy did not expire when the woman conveyed the lot to the friend.
否，因为在该女士将土地转让给朋友时，产权保险单并未失效。

C. Yes, because the tax lien was not listed as an exception on the title insurance policy.
是，因为税务留置权未被列为产权保险单上的例外情况。

D. Yes, because the woman is liable to the friend for breach of the covenant against encumbrances, and the title policy should cover the friend's potential loss.
是，因为该女士因违反无产权负担之约而对朋友负有责任，并且产权保单应承保该朋友的潜在损失。

Title insurance policies

A title insurance policy is a personal contract of indemnity that protects only the named insured (here, the woman) and their heirs from losses caused by undisclosed title defects. It does not run with the land to subsequent purchasers. The insurer is only responsible for losses sustained by the named insured. Since the friend is not a named insured on the policy, she has no contractual right to file a claim. The title insurance company is therefore not obligated to pay the friend's claim.

(Choice B) The status of the woman's policy after the transfer is not the central issue. A title insurance policy protects the named insured (the woman), not subsequent owners. The reason the company is not obligated to pay is that the friend is not an insured party, making the reason in this choice irrelevant.

(Choice C) Although the tax lien was an undisclosed defect that would have been covered, this coverage extends only to the named insured (the woman). It does not create an obligation to a third party, like the friend, who is not a party to the insurance contract.

(Choice D) A quitclaim deed, which the woman used, contains no covenants or warranties of title, including the covenant against encumbrances. Therefore, the woman is not liable to the friend for the tax lien. Since the woman has no liability, she has suffered no loss and thus has no claim to make under her own policy.

Educational objective:
Title insurance policies are personal contracts that protect only the named insureds. They do not run with the land, and subsequent purchasers cannot make a claim under a prior owner's policy.

产权保险单是一份个人赔偿合同，仅保护指定的被保险人（本案中为该女士）及其继承人免受未披露产权瑕疵所造成的损失。它不会随土地转移给后续的购买者。保险人只对指定被保险人所遭受的损失负责。由于该朋友并非保单上的指定被保险人，她没有合同权利提出索赔。因此，产权保险公司没有义务支付该朋友的索赔。

（选项B）转让后该女士保单的状态并非核心问题。产权保险单保护的是指定被保险人（该女士），而非后续的所有者。保险公司无需赔付的原因是该朋友并非受保方，这使得该选项中的理由不相关。

（选项C）尽管税务留置权是一个未披露的、本应在承保范围内的瑕疵，但这种保障仅适用于指定被保险人（该女士）。它并不对非保险合同方的第三方（如该朋友）产生赔付义务。

（选项D）该女士使用的是一份产权放弃契据（quitclaim deed），这种契据不包含任何产权保证或契约，包括无产权负担之约。因此，该女士对该朋友不因税务留置权而承担责任。由于该女士没有责任，她也就没有遭受损失，因此她自己也无法根据其保单提出索赔。

教学目标：
产权保险单是个人合同，仅保护指定的被保险人。它不随土地转移，后续的购买者不能根据前任业主的保单提出索佩。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property (不动产法)
✅ 正确答案：A
📚 核心考点：产权保险的性质

产权保险 (Title Insurance) 是一份个人赔偿合同 (Personal Contract of Indemnity)。它仅保护保单上列明的被保险人 (Named Insured)，并不随土地所有权的转移而自动转移给新的买家 (Does not run with the land)。

⚖️ 法律推理逻辑

1. 合同相对性原则 (Privity of Contract)
产权保险合同是保险公司与“女士”之间签订的。该“朋友”并未购买保险，也不是保单上的受益人。因此，朋友与保险公司之间不存在合同关系，无权直接向保险公司索赔。
2. 业主保单的覆盖范围
业主保单 (Owner's Policy) 通常在被保险人拥有房产期间，或者在转让房产后仍因之前的担保契约 (Warranty Deed) 承担法律责任时有效。
3. 免责契据的关键作用 (Quitclaim Deed)
这是本题的第二个关键点。女士通过免责契据 (Quitclaim Deed)将土地转让给了朋友。
  • 免责契据不包含任何产权保证 (No Covenants of Title)。
  • 这意味着女士不对朋友承诺土地无负担 (No Covenant Against Encumbrances)。
因此，朋友不能起诉女士赔偿税务留置权的损失。既然女士对朋友没有赔偿责任，女士也就没有遭受“损失”，她的保险公司自然无需介入（即使女士自己去索赔，因为没有实际损失，保险公司也不会赔付）。
🚫 为什么选项 D 是最大的陷阱？
选项 D 认为女士违反了“无产权负担之约” (Covenant Against Encumbrances)。

如果女士使用的是担保契约 (Warranty Deed)，那么她确实对朋友负有责任，这种情况下，虽然朋友不能直接起诉保险公司，但朋友可以起诉女士，女士再找保险公司理赔。

但题目明确指出使用的是免责契据 (Quitclaim Deed)，这切断了女士的责任链条，也彻底切断了保险赔付的可能性。
其他选项简析：
  • 选项 B： 保单是否过期不是重点，重点是索赔人（朋友）不是合同当事人。
  • 选项 C： 虽然税务留置权属于保险漏项，但保险公司只对被保险人负责，不对全世界负责。
MBE 备考建议：注意区分 Deed 类型与保险受益人范围

questions.question:
A man conveyed a large tract of land to a buyer by a warranty deed. The buyer recorded the deed four days later. After the conveyance but prior to the buyer's recording of the deed, a creditor properly filed a judgment against the man.
A statute in the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."
The recording act has no provision for a grace period.
The creditor joined both the man and the buyer in an appropriate action to foreclose her judgment lien against the land.
If the creditor is unsuccessful, what will be the reason?

choices.a: Any deed is superior to a judgment lien.
choices.b: Four days is not an unreasonable delay in recording a deed.
choices.c: The creditor is not a purchaser for value.
choices.d: The man's warranty of title to the buyer defeats the creditor's claim.

data.questionStem:
Q86199

A man conveyed a large tract of land to a buyer by a warranty deed. The buyer recorded the deed four days later. After the conveyance but prior to the buyer's recording of the deed, a creditor properly filed a judgment against the man.

A statute in the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice unless the same be recorded according to law."

The recording act has no provision for a grace period.

The creditor joined both the man and the buyer in an appropriate action to foreclose her judgment lien against the land.

If the creditor is unsuccessful, what will be the reason?

一名男子通过一份担保契约将一大片土地转让给了一名买家。买家在四天后登记了该契约。在土地转让之后，但在买家登记契约之前，一名债权人合法地登记了一项针对该男子的判决。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何合法登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，均构成对判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或此后获得的不动产的留置权。”

该司法管辖区的登记法案规定：“任何不动产的转让或抵押，除非依法登记，否则不得对抗善意有偿的后续购买人。”

该登记法案没有宽限期的规定。

债权人在一项适当的诉讼中，将该男子和买家均列为被告，以行使其对该土地的判决留置权。

如果债权人败诉，原因会是什么？
options:
A. Any deed is superior to a judgment lien.
任何契约都优先于判决留置权。

B. Four days is not an unreasonable delay in recording a deed.
四天内登记契约并非不合理的延迟。

C. The creditor is not a purchaser for value.
债权人并非有偿购买人。

D. The man's warranty of title to the buyer defeats the creditor's claim.
该男子向买家作出的所有权担保可以推翻债权人的主张。
data.explanation:
Payment of value (bona fide purchaser)


ValueNo value
  • Release of existing debt
  • Fair market value
  • Security for existing debt
  • Nominal payment (eg, $1)
  • Recital of consideration in deed
  • Gift, devise, or inheritance
Recording acts are used to evaluate the priority of competing property interests. A notice act (as seen here) protects only subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of prior interests in land. Judgment creditors are not purchasers for value since the attachment of a judgment lien to a debtor's property is merely security for a preexisting debt (ie, no new value has been paid). Therefore, judgment creditors are not protected under the notice act,† and the creditor here will be unsuccessful in her foreclosure action.

†However, some recording acts now expressly protect judgment creditors by their terms.

(Choice A) It is untrue that any deed is superior to a judgment lien. Had the creditor's judgment lien been filed before the man conveyed the land to the buyer, it would have been superior to the buyer's deed.

(Choice B) When, as here, a recording act does not have a grace period, a purchaser must record immediately to prevent a subsequent purchaser from obtaining a superior interest in the property. Whether a delay in recording is reasonable is not taken into consideration.

(Choice D) A warranty deed does not defeat a competing interest in land, such as that held by a judgment creditor. Instead, a warranty deed merely allows a grantee to sue the grantor in the event that the competing interest results in a grantor's breach of a warranty under the deed.

Educational objective: Judgment creditors are not purchasers for value since the attachment of a judgment lien to a debtor's property is merely security for a preexisting debt - not payment of value.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 13%，C选项 57%（正确选项），D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

支付对价（善意购买人）


构成对价不构成对价
  • 免除现有债务
  • 公平市场价值
  • 为现有债务提供担保
  • 名义上的付款（例如，1美元）
  • 契约中对价的叙述
  • 赠与、遗赠或继承
登记法案用于评估相互冲突的财产权的优先顺序。一个通知法案（如本案所示）仅保护那些对土地上的先前权益没有通知的有偿后续购买人。判决债权人并非有偿购买人，因为将判决留置权附加于债务人的财产仅仅是为既存债务提供担保（即没有支付新的对价）。因此，判决债权人不受通知法案的保护†，本案中的债权人在其强制执行留置权的诉讼中将会败诉。

†但是，现在一些登记法案的条款明确保护判决债权人。

(选项 A) 任何契约都优先于判决留置权的说法是不正确的。如果债权人的判决留置权在该男子将土地转让给买家之前登记，那么它将优先于买家的契约。

(选项 B) 当登记法案（如本案）没有宽限期时，购买人必须立即登记，以防止后续购买人获得对该财产的优先权益。登记的延迟是否合理不在考虑范围之内。

(选项 D) 担保契约不能推翻土地上与之竞争的权益，例如判决债权人所持有的权益。相反，担保契约仅允许受让人在竞争性权益导致出让人违反契约项下的担保时，对出让人提起诉讼。

教学目标：判决债权人并非有偿购买人，因为将判决留置权附加于债务人的财产仅是为既存债务提供担保——而非支付了对价。

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Recording Acts & Priorities
📅 案件发生顺序
时间点 1 出让人将土地转让给买家 (Conveyance)
时间点 2 债权人登记判决 (Judgment Filed)
时间点 3 买家登记契约 (Buyer Records)

本题的核心冲突在于：未登记的先前买家 vs 后续登记的判决债权人。

核心考点：保护对象的资格

美国的登记法案（Recording Acts）旨在保护特定的后续权利人。本题中的法案明确规定保护对象为：

"Subsequent Purchasers for Value"
（善意有偿的后续购买人）

要赢得这场优先权之争，债权人必须证明自己符合上述定义。

✅ 正确答案：C

理由：债权人不是有偿购买人 (Purchaser for Value)。

在大多数司法管辖区和MBE考试的默认规则中：

  • 判决债权人 (Judgment Creditor) 仅仅是为了担保“既存债务” (antecedent debt) 而对债务人的财产确立留置权。
  • 他们并没有在这个特定的土地交易中支付新的对价 (new value)。

结论：因为债权人不是“购买人”，所以他不受登记法案的保护。案件回到普通法规则 (Common Law)：即“先在时间上，先在权利上” (First in time, first in right)。

当债权人登记判决时（时间点2），该男子已经将土地转让给了买家（时间点1）。虽然买家没登记，但产权已经转移。因此，该男子名下已无该土地，判决留置权无法附着。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？
A. 任何契约都优先于判决留置权
太绝对了。如果债权人在土地转让之前就登记了判决，留置权就会附着在土地上，买家获得的土地将带有该留置权负担。
B. 四天不是不合理的延迟
这是干扰项。本题适用的是通知型法案（Notice Act），而非纯粹考察“合理时间”。如果没有宽限期 (grace period)，即使延迟一天，只要出现了受保护的后续购买人，先前的买家就会输。本题买家赢是因为债权人资格不够，而不是因为买家动作快。
D. 担保契约 (Warranty Deed) 的作用
担保契约只是让买家在失去产权时可以起诉卖家赔偿，它本身并没有对抗第三人（如债权人）的法律效力。
🎓 MBE 拿分技巧：

遇到 Recording Act 的题目，务必按照以下步骤检查：
  1. 看身份：后续者是购买人 (Purchaser)、抵押权人 (Mortgagee) 还是判决债权人 (Judgment Creditor)？
  2. 定规则：如果是判决债权人，除非题目中的法规明确写了保护 "Creditors"，否则默认他们不是 Purchaser for Value，不受登记法保护。
  3. 看结果：不受保护 = 回归普通法 = 先买的人赢（无论是否登记）。

questions.question:
A developer entered into a valid written contract to purchase a large tract of land from a contractor for its fair market value of $500,000. The contract was assignable by the developer. The developer duly notified the contractor to convey title to her and her business partner whom the developer had not seen for many years.
When the developer learned that the business partner would have to sign certain documents in connection with the closing, she prevailed upon her brother to attend the closing and pretend to be the business partner. The developer and the brother attended the closing, and the contractor executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed purporting to convey the land to the developer and the business partner as tenants in common. The brother pretended that he was the business partner, and he signed the business partner's name to all the required documents. The developer provided the entire $500,000 consideration for the transaction. The deed was promptly and properly recorded.
Unknown to the developer or her brother, the business partner had died several months before the closing. The business partner's will, which was duly probated, devised "All my real estate to my nephew" and the residue of his estate to the developer.
The developer and nephew have been unable to agree as to the status or disposition of the land. The nephew brought an appropriate action against the contractor and the developer to quiet legal title to an undivided one-half interest in the land.
In whom should the court hold that legal title to the land has vested?

choices.a: All in the contractor.
choices.b: All in the developer.
choices.c: One-half in the developer and one-half in the contractor.
choices.d: One-half in the developer and one-half in the nephew.

data.questionStem:
Q86223

A developer entered into a valid written contract to purchase a large tract of land from a contractor for its fair market value of $500,000. The contract was assignable by the developer. The developer duly notified the contractor to convey title to her and her business partner whom the developer had not seen for many years.

When the developer learned that the business partner would have to sign certain documents in connection with the closing, she prevailed upon her brother to attend the closing and pretend to be the business partner. The developer and the brother attended the closing, and the contractor executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed purporting to convey the land to the developer and the business partner as tenants in common. The brother pretended that he was the business partner, and he signed the business partner's name to all the required documents. The developer provided the entire $500,000 consideration for the transaction. The deed was promptly and properly recorded.

Unknown to the developer or her brother, the business partner had died several months before the closing. The business partner's will, which was duly probated, devised "All my real estate to my nephew" and the residue of his estate to the developer.

The developer and nephew have been unable to agree as to the status or disposition of the land. The nephew brought an appropriate action against the contractor and the developer to quiet legal title to an undivided one-half interest in the land.

In whom should the court hold that legal title to the land has vested?

一名开发商与一名承包商签订了一份有效的书面合同，以500,000美元的公平市场价格向其购买一大片土地。该合同可由开发商转让。开发商正式通知承包商，将产权转让给她以及她多年未见的商业伙伴。

当开发商得知其商业伙伴必须签署与交易过户相关的某些文件时，她说服了她的兄弟出席交易过户并冒充该商业伙伴。开发商和她的兄弟出席了交易过户，承包商签署了一份符合地契适当形式的文书，意图将土地作为共同共有（tenants in common）财产转让给开发商和该商业伙伴。其兄弟冒充商业伙伴，并在所有要求的文件上签署了商业伙伴的名字。开发商为该交易提供了全部500,000美元的对价。该地契被及时并妥善地登记备案。

开发商和她的兄弟都不知道，该商业伙伴在交易过户前几个月已经去世。该商业伙伴的遗嘱已通过正式的遗嘱认证程序，其中规定“将我所有的不动产遗赠给我的侄子”，并将其遗产的剩余部分遗赠给开发商。

开发商和侄子未能就该土地的法律状态或处置达成一致。侄子对承包商和开发商提起了适当的诉讼，要求对该土地中未分割的二分之一权益进行产权确认（quiet legal title）。

法院应裁定该土地的合法产权归属于谁？
options:
A. All in the contractor.
全部归属于承包商。

B. All in the developer.
全部归属于开发商。

C. One-half in the developer and one-half in the contractor.
二分之一归属于开发商，二分之一归属于承包商。

D. One-half in the developer and one-half in the nephew.
二分之一归属于开发商，二分之一归属于侄子。

Deed requirements


RequirementsValidInvalid
Written & signed by grantorAny written instrument signed by grantorOral (except permissible gift) Signed only by grantee
Identifies grantor & granteeSeparate grantor & grantee (except concurrent estates) Identifiable by name or descriptionAmbiguous/unidentifiable grantee(s) Nonexistent grantee
Identifies landIdentifiable by reasonable certainty - eg:
  • Government survey
  • Metes & bounds
  • Street, lot, house number
Ambiguous description (but extrinsic evidence admissible) Undefined part of larger parcel
Includes words of transfer"Convey" "Transfer" "Grant" "Sell""Lease" "Rent" "License"
A tenancy in common is a concurrent ownership interest in land where each co-tenant has a separate share of the property but an equal right to possess the whole property (ie, separate but undivided interests). Co-tenants can receive this interest under a deed, but that deed is only valid if it:
  • is in writing and signed by the grantor
  • unambiguously identifies the grantor and grantee
  • unambiguously describes the land and
  • includes words of transfer.

A deed that names a nonexistent co-tenant is void as to that co-tenant. Therefore, the grantor retains the nonexistent co-tenant's interest and becomes tenants in common with the other co-tenant(s) named in the deed.

Here, the contractor attempted to deed land to the business partner and developer as tenants in common. But since the business partner had died several months earlier (and was therefore a nonexistent co-tenant), the portion of the deed naming him as grantee is void. Therefore, the court should hold that the contractor (the grantor) and the developer (other co-tenant) each have one-half interests in the land as tenants in common (Choices A & B).

(Choice D) Although the business partner devised his property to the nephew, the business partner had already died when the contractor attempted to deed him the land. Therefore, the deed did not convey the business partner an interest in the land that could pass to the nephew.

Educational objective: When a tenancy in common is deeded to a nonexistent (eg, deceased) co-tenant, the deed is void as to that co-tenant and the grantor retains the co-tenant's interest. As a result, a tenancy in common forms between the grantor and the other co-tenant(s) named in the deed.

选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 25%，C选项 23%（正确选项），D选项 23%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

地契要件


要件有效无效
由出让人书写并签署任何由出让人签署的书面文书口头形式（除允许的赠与外） 仅由受让人签署
明确出让人与受让人出让人与受让人为不同主体（共同产权除外） 可通过姓名或描述识别受让人身份模糊/无法识别 不存在的受让人
明确土地可通过合理的确信度进行识别 - 例如：
  • 政府勘测
  • 界限描述
  • 街道、地块、门牌号
描述模糊（但可接纳外在证据） 更大包裹中未定义的部分
包含转让意图的词语“转让”、“转移”、“授予”、“出售”“租赁”、“出租”、“许可”
共同共有（tenancy in common）是一种土地的共同所有权权益，其中每个共有人拥有财产的独立份额，但享有占有整个财产的平等权利（即独立但未分割的权益）。共有人可以通过地契获得此项权益，但该地契仅在以下情况下有效：
  • 由出让人书写并签署
  • 明确无误地识别出让人和受让人
  • 明确无误地描述土地以及
  • 包含转让意图的词语。

一份指定了不存在的共有人的地契，就该共有人而言是无效的。因此，出让人保留了该不存在共有人的权益，并与地契中指定的其他共有人形成共同共有（tenants in common）关系。

在本案中，承包商试图将土地作为共同共有财产转让给商业伙伴和开发商。但由于商业伙伴已于数月前去世（因此是一个不存在的共有人），地契中指定他为受让人的部分是无效的。因此，法院应裁定承包商（出让人）和开发商（其他共有人）作为共同共有人（tenants in common）各拥有该土地二分之一的权益（因此选项A和B错误）。

（选项D）尽管商业伙伴将他的财产遗赠给了侄子，但在承包商试图将土地转让给他时，该商业伙伴已经去世。因此，该地契并未将土地权益转让给商业伙伴，该权益也就无法转移给侄子。

教学目的：当一份共同共有（tenancy in common）的地契被转让给一个不存在的（例如，已故的）共有人时，该地契就该共有人而言是无效的，出让人保留该共有人的权益。其结果是，在出让人和地契中指定的其他共有人之间形成共同共有关系。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：RP (Real Property)

本题考察的是不动产法中关于地契有效性 (Validity of Deeds) 和 共同共有 (Tenancy in Common) 的核心规则。

1. 核心考点：受让人必须存在

规则 (The Rule) 地契要有效转让产权，受让人 (Grantee) 必须在交付时是存在且活着的实体。

"A deed to a nonexistent grantee is void."

如果地契上的受让人在产权过户 (Closing/Delivery) 前已经死亡，那么针对该受让人的转让是自始无效 (Void ab initio) 的。

2. 案情分析

  • 意图：承包商 (Contractor) 想要将土地转让给开发商 (Developer) 和商业伙伴 (Business Partner) 作为按份共有人 (Tenants in Common)。
  • 事实：商业伙伴在过户前几个月已经去世。
  • 后果：
    • 对开发商的转让：有效。
    • 对商业伙伴的转让：无效 (Void)，因为他是“不存在的受让人”。

3. 产权归属的计算

由于这本来是一个按份共有 (Tenancy in Common)，没有生存者取得权 (Right of Survivorship)。

因此，原本打算给商业伙伴的那 1/2 产权未能转出，仍然保留在出让人（承包商）手中。

1/2 权益 开发商
(Developer) 地契有效
1/2 权益 承包商
(Contractor) 保留未转出的部分

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 D (侄子)：
侄子是商业伙伴的继承人。但是，商业伙伴从未获得过这块土地的产权（因为他在过户前就死了）。既然他没有产权，他的遗嘱就无法处置这块土地。你不能继承死者从未拥有的东西。

❌ 选项 B (全部归开发商)：
虽然开发商支付了全部款项，但题目问的是法定产权 (Legal Title)。

  • 如果是 Joint Tenancy (联合共有)，某些司法管辖区可能允许幸存者获得全部，但这里是 Tenancy in Common。
  • 开发商支付了全款可能让她拥有衡平法上的留置权 (Equitable Lien) 或主张归复信托 (Resulting Trust)，但这属于衡平法救济，不改变地契表面上的“法定产权”状态。

❌ 选项 A (全部归承包商)：
地契对开发商的部分是完全有效的，承包商已经成功转让了那一半。

5. 考试陷阱提示

⚠️ 干扰项分析：冒名顶替 题目中提到兄弟冒充商业伙伴签字。这在本题中是干扰信息。

虽然兄弟伪造签名可能涉及欺诈，但核心问题在于受让人已死。即使兄弟不签字，只要受让人已死，地契给死者的那部分就是无效的。
MBE Real Property Review
Focus: Deeds & Concurrent Estates

questions.question:
Fifteen years ago, a father and daughter lived on a large 15-acre tract of land owned by the father. The land consists of three five-acre sections that are generally known as the home, the barn, and the hunting cabin. Due to the father's deteriorating health, he decided to move into an assisted living facility. The daughter soon realized that she could not perform all of the duties required to maintain the 15-acre tract. When she asked the father for permission to sell the land, he refused. Against the father's will, she proceeded to list the 15-acre tract for sale in the local newspaper. A couple who was new to the area contacted the daughter with a cash offer to buy the tract. The daughter prepared a warranty deed conveying the tract to the couple and forged her father's signature on the deed.
For the last 14 years, the couple has lived in the home and maintained the surrounding five acres. During each hunting season, the couple occasionally spends time at the hunting cabin and hunts on that five-acre portion of the property. However, the couple has never used the five acres surrounding the barn.
Recently, the couple learned that the signature on the deed was a forgery and filed suit to quiet title based on adverse possession. The period of time to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
In an action to determine title, what portion of the 15-acre tract will the court likely award the couple?

choices.a: None, because the couple's possession of the farm was not hostile to the father.
choices.b: The five acres surrounding the home, because that was the only portion of the land continuously used by the couple.
choices.c: The 10 acres surrounding the home and the cabin, because those were the only portions of the land actually possessed by the couple.
choices.d: All 15 acres, because the deed described the entire 15-acre tract.

questions.question:
A seller owned a tract of land in fee simple. The seller executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to a buyer in fee simple. The instrument recited that the conveyance was in consideration of "$5 cash in hand paid and for other good and valuable consideration." The seller handed the instrument to the buyer and the buyer promptly and properly recorded it.
Two months later, the seller brought an appropriate action against the buyer to cancel the instrument and to quiet title. In support, the seller proved that no money in fact had been paid by the buyer, notwithstanding the recitation, and that no other consideration of any kind had been supplied by the buyer.
In such action, should the seller prevail?

choices.a: No, because any remedy the seller might have had was lost when the instrument was recorded.
choices.b: No, because the validity of conveyance of land does not depend upon consideration being paid, whether recited or not.
choices.c: Yes, because recordation does not make a void instrument effective.
choices.d: Yes, because the recitation of consideration paid may be contradicted by parol evidence.

data.questionStem:
Q86232

A seller owned a tract of land in fee simple. The seller executed an instrument in the proper form of a deed, purporting to convey the land to a buyer in fee simple. The instrument recited that the conveyance was in consideration of "$5 cash in hand paid and for other good and valuable consideration." The seller handed the instrument to the buyer and the buyer promptly and properly recorded it.

Two months later, the seller brought an appropriate action against the buyer to cancel the instrument and to quiet title. In support, the seller proved that no money in fact had been paid by the buyer, notwithstanding the recitation, and that no other consideration of any kind had been supplied by the buyer.

In such action, should the seller prevail?

一位卖方以完全所有权(fee simple)拥有一块土地。该卖方签署了一份符合契约(deed)适当形式的文书，意图将该土地以完全所有权(fee simple)转让给一位买方。该文书载明，此次转让的对价为“已付现金5美元以及其他有益且有价值的对价”。卖方将该文书交给买方，买方随即进行了妥善且及时的登记。

两个月后，卖方向买方提起了适当的诉讼，请求撤销该文书并提起确认所有权之诉(quiet title)。为支持其诉求，卖方证明，尽管文书中有此记载，但买方实际上并未支付任何款项，也未提供任何其他形式的对价。

在该诉讼中，卖方应否胜诉？
options:
A. No, because any remedy the seller might have had was lost when the instrument was recorded.
不应胜诉，因为卖方可能拥有的任何救济措施，在文书被登记时即已丧失。

B. No, because the validity of conveyance of land does not depend upon consideration being paid, whether recited or not.
不应胜诉，因为土地转让的有效性不取决于对价是否已支付，无论文书中是否载明。

C. Yes, because recordation does not make a void instrument effective.
应胜诉，因为登记并不能使一份无效文书生效。

D. Yes, because the recitation of consideration paid may be contradicted by parol evidence.
应胜诉，因为对已付对价的记载，可通过口头证据(parol evidence)予以反驳。
data.explanation:
Transfer by deed


Essential deed components
  • Writing signed by grantor
  • Identity of grantor & grantee
  • Description of land
  • Words of transfer
Grantor's present intent to transfer title Presumed upon:
Delivery
  • physical delivery of deed
  • recording
  • unconditional delivery to agent
  • grantee's possession of property/deed
Acceptance
  • Presumed when transfer benefits grantee
A plaintiff can bring a quiet title action to establish his/her title to land above all others (eg, by disputing the validity of a deed). A deed is an instrument used to convey an interest in real property from the owner (grantor) to another (grantee). The conveyance is effective once the deed is:
  • delivered by the grantor - presumed when the deed has been recorded or is in the grantee's possession and
  • accepted by the grantee - presumed when the conveyance is beneficial to the grantee.


The validity of the conveyance does not depend upon consideration (eg, payment for the property) - even if the deed states that consideration has been paid. However, the grantee may be liable for nonpayment.

Here, the seller properly executed a deed purporting to convey a tract of land to the buyer. The seller handed the deed to the buyer (delivery), who accepted and recorded it. And though the buyer never paid the "$5 cash in hand" or other consideration recited in the deed, the validity of the conveyance did not depend upon consideration being paid. Therefore, the transfer to the buyer was effective, and the seller should not prevail in his quiet title action.

(Choice A) Recording a deed (ie, depositing it into the official land records) does not cure any defects in the conveyance. Therefore, no remedy the seller might have had was lost when the deed was recorded.

(Choice C) Recording a void deed - a legally invalid deed that cannot prove title (eg, a forged deed) - does not make the deed effective. But here, the deed was not void since it was properly executed, delivered, and accepted.

(Choice D) Parol evidence - extrinsic evidence offered to contradict or modify a document - is admissible to show that the consideration recited in a deed has not been paid. But while that evidence is relevant to the grantee's liability for nonpayment, it does not affect the validity of the conveyance since consideration is not required. Therefore, the seller will not prevail by contradicting the consideration recited in the deed.

Educational objective: A deed effectively transfers an interest in real property when the deed is (1) delivered by the grantor and (2) accepted by the grantee. Consideration is not required, even when the deed states that consideration has been paid.

选项正确率统计：A选项 13%，B选项 59%（正确选项），C选项 17%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

通过契约转让


契约基本要素
  • 由出让人签署的书面文件
  • 出让人与受让人的身份信息
  • 土地描述
  • 转让措辞
出让人转让所有权的当前意图，在下列情况下推定成立：
交付
  • 契约的实际交付
  • 登记
  • 向代理人的无条件交付
  • 受让人占有财产/契约
接受
  • 当转让对受让人有利时，推定其已接受
原告可以提起确认所有权之诉(quiet title action)，以确立其对土地的所有权高于其他任何人（例如，通过质疑一份契约的有效性）。契约(deed)是一种用于将不动产权益从所有者（出让人）转让给他人（受让人）的文书。一旦契约被：
  • 由出让人交付——当契约已被登记或由受让人占有时，即推定已交付并且
  • 被受让人接受——当转让对受让人有利时，即推定已接受，则该转让生效。


转让的有效性不取决于对价(consideration)（例如，为财产支付的款项）——即使契约中声明已支付对价。但是，受让人可能因未付款而承担责任。

在本案中，卖方妥善地签署了一份意图将一块土地转让给买方的契约。卖方将契约交给了买方（交付），买方接受并登记了该契约。而且，尽管买方从未支付契约中记载的“已付现金5美元”或其他对价，但转让的有效性并不取决于对价是否已支付。因此，向买方的转让是有效的，卖方在其确认所有权之诉(quiet title action)中不应胜诉。

(选项 A) 登记一份契约（即，将其存入官方土地记录）并不能补救转让中的任何瑕疵。因此，卖方可能拥有的任何救济措施并不会因为契约被登记而丧失。

(选项 C) 登记一份无效契约——即一份法律上无效且不能证明所有权的契约（例如，伪造的契约）——并不能使该契约生效。但在本案中，该契约并不是无效的，因为它已被妥善签署、交付和接受。

(选项 D) 口头证据(Parol evidence)——为反驳或修改一份文件而提出的外在证据——可以被采纳，以证明契约中记载的对价并未支付。但是，尽管该证据与受让人因未付款而应承担的责任相关，它却不影响转让的有效性，因为对价并非必要条件。因此，卖方无法通过反驳契约中记载的对价来获得胜诉。

教学目标：当一份契约被 (1) 出让人交付且 (2) 被受让人接受时，该契约即有效地转让了不动产的权益。对价并非必要条件，即使契约中声明已支付对价。

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Wills & Other Donative Transfers § 6.3 (Am. Law Inst. 2003) (gifts of land).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Deeds & Consideration

核心考点 (Key Principle) 不动产契约 (Deed) 的有效性不取决于对价 (Consideration) 是否已支付。只要契约被有效交付 (Delivered) 并被接受 (Accepted)，产权即发生转移。

本题的正确答案是 B。

为什么卖方不能撤销契约？

在合同法 (Contracts) 中，缺乏对价可能导致合同无法执行。但在财产法 (Property) 中，契约 (Deed) 的功能是转让权益 (Conveyance)，而非单纯的承诺。

  • 赠与有效性： 即使是纯粹的赠与 (Gift)，只要满足契约的形式要求并完成交付，产权转移就是有效的。
  • 记载的意义： 契约中记载 "$5 cash" 属于惯用语，即使这笔钱没付，也不影响产权转移的效力。
  • 补救措施： 卖方可以起诉买方要求支付那 $5，但不能要求收回土地 (Rescind the deed)。
契约生效的必要条件 (Requirements)

一份有效的 Deed 只需要满足以下条件：

  1. 书面形式 (Writing)：由出让人 (Grantor) 签署。
  2. 当事人与土地 (Parties & Land)：明确指认双方及土地描述。
  3. 转让意图 (Donative Intent)：包含转让的措辞。
  4. 交付与接受 (Delivery & Acceptance)：本题中卖方亲手交给买方，且买方已登记，满足此条件。

注意：对价 (Consideration) 不是必要条件！

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (错误)：
登记 (Recording) 本身并不能“切断”卖方的救济权利。如果契约本身是因欺诈或伪造而无效的，登记并不能使其变有效。卖方输掉官司是因为契约本身有效，而不是因为买方登记了。
选项 C (错误)：
前半句是对的（登记不能使无效文书生效），但前提错误。本案中的契约不是无效的 (Void)，它是一个完美的、有效的转让文书，只是没付钱而已。
选项 D (陷阱项)：
这是一个典型的 MBE 干扰项。口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 确实允许引入证据证明钱没付。
但是： 这种证据只能用来证明买方欠卖方 $5 的债务，而不能用来证明契约无效或推翻产权转移。证据可采，但无法达到卖方想要“撤销契约”的目的。
MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 看到 "Deed" 和 "Consideration" 同时出现时，请立即联想：Deed 不需要对价。

区分 Contract for Sale of Land（需要对价）和 Deed（执行阶段，不需要对价）。一旦进入 Deed 阶段，未付对价通常只会产生金钱债务，不会导致产权回转。

questions.question:
An owner owned a single-family residence. Fifteen years ago, the owner conveyed a life estate in the house to a landlord. Fourteen years ago, the landlord, who had taken possession of the house, leased the house to a tenant for a term of 15 years at the monthly rental of $500. Eleven years ago, the landlord died intestate leaving her son as her sole heir. The tenant regularly paid rent to the landlord and, after the landlord's death, to her son until last month.
The period in which to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.
In an appropriate action, the tenant, the owner, and the landlord's son each asserted ownership of the house.
Who now owns the house?

choices.a: The landlord's son, because the landlord asserted a claim adverse to the owner when she executed a lease to the tenant.
choices.b: The landlord's son, because the tenant's occupation was attributable to the son and the landlord died 11 years ago.
choices.c: The owner, because the owner held a reversion and the landlord has died.
choices.d: The tenant, because of his physical occupancy and because his term ended with the landlord's death.

data.questionStem:
Q86241

An owner owned a single-family residence. Fifteen years ago, the owner conveyed a life estate in the house to a landlord. Fourteen years ago, the landlord, who had taken possession of the house, leased the house to a tenant for a term of 15 years at the monthly rental of $500. Eleven years ago, the landlord died intestate leaving her son as her sole heir. The tenant regularly paid rent to the landlord and, after the landlord's death, to her son until last month.

The period in which to acquire title by adverse possession in the jurisdiction is 10 years.

In an appropriate action, the tenant, the owner, and the landlord's son each asserted ownership of the house.

Who now owns the house?

一位业主拥有一处独栋住宅。十五年前，该业主将该房屋的终身地产权(life estate)转让给了一位房东。十四年前，已占有该房屋的房东将房屋出租给了一位租户，租期为15年，月租金为500美元。十一年前，房东无遗嘱死亡，其儿子是她的唯一继承人。租户定期向房东支付租金，在房东去世后，则向其儿子支付租金，直至上个月。

在该司法管辖区，通过侵权逆占(adverse possession)取得所有权的法定时效为10年。

在一项适当的诉讼中，业主、租户和房东的儿子均主张对该房屋的所有权。

现在谁拥有这所房子？
options:
A. The landlord's son, because the landlord asserted a claim adverse to the owner when she executed a lease to the tenant.
房东的儿子，因为房东在与租户签订租约时，向业主主张了对抗性权利。

B. The landlord's son, because the tenant's occupation was attributable to the son and the landlord died 11 years ago.
房东的儿子，因为租户的占有可归因于其儿子，且房东已于11年前去世。

C. The owner, because the owner held a reversion and the landlord has died.
业主，因为业主拥有复归权(reversion)，且房东已经去世。

D. The tenant, because of his physical occupancy and because his term ended with the landlord's death.
租户，因为他的实际占有，以及他的租期因房东的去世而终止。
data.explanation:
A person may acquire title to another's land by adverse possession if his/her possession of the land is:

  • Open and notorious - apparent to a reasonable owner
  • Continuous - uninterrupted for the statutory period
  • Exclusive - not shared with the owner
  • Actual - physical presence by the adverse possessor or another whose possession is attributable to the adverse possessor (as seen here)
  • Non-permissive - hostile and adverse


Here, the owner conveyed a life estate in the house to the landlord, who leased it to the tenant. Ownership of the house reverted to the owner when the landlord died. But since the tenant remained in the house and paid rent to the landlord's son, the tenant's possession was attributable to the son. And because the house was visibly and exclusively occupied by the tenant for the 10-year statutory period without the owner's permission, the son acquired title to the house by adverse possession.

(Choice A) Life estates are alienable, which means that the life tenant can freely convey all or part of his/her interest to another (eg, by conveying a right of possession through a lease). Therefore, since the landlord (life tenant) was entitled to lease the house to the tenant during her life tenancy, she did not assert a claim adverse to the owner by doing so.

(Choice C) A reversion is a future interest retained by the grantor. Although the owner had a reversionary interest in the house (which became possessory when the landlord died), the owner lost that interest due to the son's adverse possession.

(Choice D) Although the tenant continued to occupy the house after the landlord's death for 11 years, he paid rent to the landlord's son. As a result, the tenant's possession was attributable to the son - not himself.

Educational objective: To acquire title by adverse possession, a person's possession of another's land must be open and notorious, continuous for the statutory period, exclusive, actual, and non-permissive (OCEAN). Actual presence can occur through another so long as their presence on the land is attributable to the adverse possessor.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 23%（正确选项），C选项 68%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一个人可以通过侵权逆占 (adverse possession) 取得他人土地的所有权，前提是其对土地的占有是：

  • O公开且众所周知 (Open and notorious) - 对一个理性的业主而言是显而易见的
  • C持续 (Continuous) - 在法定时效期间内不间断
  • E排他 (Exclusive) - 不与业主共享
  • A实际 (Actual) - 由侵权逆占人或其占有可归因于侵权逆占人的他人进行实际占有（如此处所示）
  • N非经许可 (Non-permissive) - 具有敌意和对抗性


在本案中，业主将房屋的终身地产权(life estate)转让给了房东，房东又将其出租给了租户。当房东去世时，房屋的所有权复归于业主。但由于租户仍居住在该房屋内，并向房东的儿子支付租金，因此租户的占有可归因于该儿子。并且因为租户在未经业主许可的情况下，对该房屋的占有是公开可见且排他的，并已持续了10年的法定时效期间，所以该儿子通过侵权逆占(adverse possession)取得了房屋的所有权。

（选项A）终身地产权(Life estate)是可转让的，这意味着终身地产权持有人可以自由地将其全部或部分权益转让给他人（例如，通过租约转让占有权）。因此，由于房东（终身地产权持有人）有权在其终身地产权存续期间将房屋出租给租户，她这样做并没有向业主主张对抗性权利。

（选项C）复归权(reversion)是授予人保留的未来权益。尽管业主对该房屋拥有复归权益（当房东去世时，该权益变为占有性权益），但由于其儿子的侵权逆占，业主丧失了该权益。

（选项D）尽管租户在房东去世后继续占有该房屋长达11年，但他向房东的儿子支付了租金。因此，租户的占有应归因于该儿子，而非其本人。

教学目标：要通过侵权逆占(adverse possession)取得所有权，一个人对他人土地的占有必须是公开且众所周知、在法定时效期间内持续、排他、实际且未经许可的（OCEAN原则）。只要他人在土地上的占有可归因于侵权逆占人，也可构成实际占有。
